title: Distance Estimation using Globular Clusters and Ultra-Compact Dwarfs
background_knowledge: 在天文学中，准确测量天体距离是理解宇宙尺度与星系物理性质的基石。球状星团（Globular Clusters, GCs）是密集且古老的恒星集团，其绝对星等与内部恒星速度色散之间存在紧密的标度关系（即GCVD关系），这使其成为一种极具潜力的独立测距指示器。另一方面，超致密矮星系（Ultra-Compact Dwarfs, UCDs）是质量和尺度介于最大型球状星团与矮星系之间的一类特殊致密天体。在球状星团光度函数的高光度端，GCs和UCDs在观测特征（如动力学质量）上呈现出平滑过渡并相互混合。理清它们在物理性质上的边界，并探究能否利用这种过渡规律构建涵盖两者的统一测距标度关系，对于近邻星系测距及揭示致密天体演化具有重要意义。
contribution: 本文探索了利用球状星团（GCs）和超致密矮星系（UCDs）建立统一测距标度关系的可能性。基于银河系、M31的GCs及文献中的UCDs样本，研究团队分析了绝对星等与动力学质量之间的双线性过渡关系。研究发现：1.若直接将GC测距关系（GCVD）应用于UCDs，会导致约33%的距离低估，但通过施加类似GC尺寸的筛选条件可消除此偏差；2.GC尺寸带来的系统误差小于GCVD关系的固有不确定度；3.使用GCs和UCDs在绝对星等-对数动力学质量平面上的双线性关系进行测距，单目标的距离不确定度约为30-35%（0.12-0.16 dex）；4.确认了GC与UCD的物理分界点大致位于 M_V ≃ -10.8 mag 及 M_dyn ≃ 3.1×10^6 M_⊙；5.将该统一标度关系应用于距离备受争议的矮星系NGC1052-DF2，测得距离为 19.1 ± 4.3 Mpc，与已有文献结果一致。
summary: The tight scaling relation between absolute magnitude and internal velocity dispersion ($σ$) for globular clusters (GCs), referred to as the GC velocity dispersion (GCVD) relation, has shown great potential as a distance estimator. However, at the high-luminosity end of the GC luminosity function, GCs mix with ultra-compact dwarfs (UCDs). As GCs appear to smoothly transition into UCDs with dynamical mass, we investigate the possibility of a unified distance estimation relation applicable to both GCs and UCDs. To this end, we exploit the transition between scaling relations with dynamical mass, using the Milky Way and M31 GCs alongside literature UCDs. Additionally, we look at the influence of UCDs, and of GC size, on GCVD-derived distances. Using the GCVD for UCDs gives a systematic distance underestimation of $\sim$33 per cent, but a cut to select UCDs with GC-like sizes can eliminate this bias. The minor systematics on GC size produce systematic offsets smaller than the uncertainty of the GCVD. Using the bilinear relation formed by the GCs and UCDs in the absolute magnitude - log dynamical mass plane for distance estimation yields per-object distance uncertainties of $\sim$30-35 per cent (0.12-0.16 dex). We find that the GC - UCD division occurs at $M_V \simeq -10.8$ mag and $M_{dyn} \simeq 3.1\times10^6$ $M_{\odot}$, consistent with previous findings. Applied to the dwarf galaxy NGC1052-DF2, whose distance is strongly debated, the relation returns 19.1 $\pm$ 4.3 Mpc, consistent with literature values.

title: A ready-to-deploy MLOps software platform for satellite and NEO detection at meter-class ground-based observatories
background_knowledge: 地基天文观测图像中经常会出现由人造卫星、空间碎片或近地天体（NEO）在曝光期间移动而留下的条纹状轨迹。对这些轨迹的准确探测不仅对于天文数据清洗至关重要，更是空间态势感知（SSA）和行星防御任务的核心。近年来，机器学习（ML）技术在识别这些图像特征方面表现出极高的可靠性。然而，从纯科研导向的算法模型到天文台日常运行的落地应用之间存在着巨大的鸿沟。由于缺乏用于可视化人工复核、工作流管理和结构化数据存储的集成化软件工具，机器学习模型在实际观测运维中的普及受到了极大限制，这已成为现代天文计算领域亟待解决的软件工程与机器学习运维（MLOps）挑战。
contribution: 本文提出并开发了StreakMind Workbench软件平台，将MLOps（机器学习运维）实践引入天文观测，搭建了连接科研级机器学习流水线与天文台日常运行的桥梁。该平台并非旨在提出新的探测算法，而是致力于解决天文计算中的软件工程问题，在维持核心科学代码唯一权威性的同时，为天文学家提供业务化的操作环境。平台采用Python与PyQt5开发，支持从FITS图像摄入、模型推理、结果可视化复核、数据库探索、模型训练管理到生成小行星中心（MPC）标准格式记录的全端到端工作流。通过在La Sagra天文台的273张图像上进行验证，证明了该平台能成功实现业务化运转，有效助力米级地基望远镜与中等规模观测项目在空间态势感知和行星防御方面的实际应用。
summary:
Ground-based astronomical observations frequently contain streaks produced by artificial satellites, space debris, and potentially Near-Earth Objects (NEOs). While machine-learning models can reliably detect these features, their practical adoption in observatory operations is often limited by the lack of integrated tools for visual inspection, validation, workflow management, and structured data storage.
  This paper presents the StreakMind Workbench, a framework that applies MLOps practices to bridge research-oriented machine-learning pipelines with routine observatory operations. Rather than introducing new detection algorithms, the Workbench addresses a software-engineering challenge in astronomical computing: maintaining a single authoritative source of scientific processing code while providing astronomers with an operational environment for workflow execution and result inspection.
  Integrated with the reference StreakMind AI model of Carrillo et al. (2026) and implemented in Python using PyQt5, the Workbench supports the complete workflow from FITS ingestion to database storage, including inference, result inspection, database exploration, training management, and Minor Planet Center formatted observations. Validation on 273 images from La Sagra Observatory demonstrates successful end-to-end workflows while maintaining consistency with the underlying StreakMind scientific code. The platform facilitates operational use of a research ML pipeline in meter-class observatories and moderate-scale campaigns, supporting Space Situational Awareness and planetary defence.

title: Galaxies Below the Fundamental Metallicity Relation Are Morphologically Disturbed: Merian H$α$ Morphologies and DESI Metallicities
background_knowledge: 星系的基础金属丰度关系（Fundamental Metallicity Relation, FMR）是星系演化中的一个重要经验规律，它揭示了星系的恒星质量、恒星形成率（SFR）与气相金属丰度之间的紧密联系。通常情况下，星系的恒星质量越大，金属丰度越高；但在相同质量下，恒星形成率较高的星系，其金属丰度往往较低。这种现象的物理图像通常被解释为：活跃的恒星形成活动主要由来自星系际介质（IGM）的贫金属（原初）气体吸积或星系间的小并合所驱动，这些贫金属气体的注入在促进新恒星形成的同时，稀释了星系整体的金属丰度。此外，星系的形态特征记录了其动力学演化历史，呈现不对称或受扰动的形态通常暗示着星系近期经历了并合、相互作用或剧烈的外部气体流入事件。
contribution: 本研究利用Merian巡天的中频带成像数据（构建了恒星连续谱和Hα发射线的空间分辨图）以及DESI DR1光谱数据（提取气相氧丰度），研究了质量低至10^8 M_⊙的大样本星系，创新性地将“星系形态”作为新维度引入FMR的分析中。研究发现，金属丰度低于FMR预测值的星系在形态上表现出明显的扰动；在固定恒星质量和比恒星形成率（sSFR）的情况下，星系的金属丰度与其连续谱及Hα形态的不对称度呈显著负相关。这些观测结果（即存在极度贫金属、形态受扰动且高速形成恒星的星系群体）支持了外部事件（如并合或气体吸积）触发星暴的物理模型，表明星系形态与其金属丰度和恒星形成史密切相关，为理解低质量星系中剧烈恒星形成活动的物理驱动机制提供了新的重要观测证据。
summary: Empirical results have revealed a connection between a galaxy's metallicity, mass, and star formation rate, known as the fundamental metallicity relation (FMR), in which metallicity increases with stellar mass and decreases with SFR. Physical interpretations of the FMR suggest that actively star-forming galaxies are fueled by pristine gas, likely obtained via IGM accretion or minor mergers. Here we demonstrate the value of galaxy morphology as an additional axis in the FMR. Using medium-band imaging from the Merian Survey, we construct spatially resolved maps of stellar continuum and H$α$ emission for a large sample of galaxies with DESI DR1 spectra, reaching stellar masses down to $10^8$ M$_\odot$. We measure non-parametric morphological parameters from the emission maps and derive gas-phase oxygen abundances from the spectra using strong-line calibrations. We fit a series of simple linear models to explore correlations among the metallicity, stellar mass, sSFR, and morphological parameters. We find that galaxies that are more metal-poor than predicted by the FMR appear particularly disturbed. At fixed stellar mass and sSFR, metallicity is inversely correlated with the asymmetry of both the continuum and H$α$ morphology. The observed trends -- and the existence of particularly metal-poor, morphologically disturbed, highly star-forming galaxies -- are consistent with external burst triggering. Our results indicate that a galaxy's morphology is linked to its metallicity and star formation history, providing an additional observational probe of the physical drivers of elevated star-formation in low-mass galaxies.

title: Spectroscopic Study of the Circularly Polarised Radio Source TYC 2834-1385-1: An Active Binary
background_knowledge: 具有活跃色球层的密近双星系统（如BY天龙座型变星，BY Dra-type）通常由晚型主序星（如K型或M型矮星）组成。由于双星系统的潮汐作用导致恒星快速自转，结合其内部较深的对流层，通过磁发电机机制会产生强烈的表面磁场。这种磁活动不仅表现为显著的星斑和光学波段的色球层发射线（如强烈的Ca II H和K线），还会通过等离子体过程在低频射电波段产生圆偏振辐射。通过高分辨率光学光谱测量双星的视向速度变化（双线分光双星），可以精确测定其轨道周期、质量比和恒星类型，从而揭示此类射电源的物理本质。
contribution: 本研究利用Mercator望远镜上的HERMES光谱仪，对一个先前未分类的圆偏振射电源TYC 2834-1385-1进行了高分辨率（R=85,000）光学光谱观测。研究成功将其认证为双线分光双星，通过金属吸收线和Ca II发射线测量出其轨道周期为3.601±0.002天，两子星视向速度半幅值相近。观测到强烈的Ca II H和K发射线，证明其为一个包含两颗晚G/早K型（初步分类为K0V）主序星的BY Dra型活跃双星。这是在低频射电巡天中发现候选体后，首批通过光谱学成功证认为色球层活跃双星的系统之一。
summary: Close binaries with active chromospheres have recently been shown to emit circularly polarised radio emission at low frequencies, motivating detailed studies of their orbital properties. We present high-resolution ($R=85,000$) optical spectroscopy of TYC 2834-1385-1, a previously unclassified radio source, obtained with the HERMES spectrograph on the Mercator Telescope. We identify the source as a double-lined spectroscopic binary and measure radial velocities from both metallic absorption and Ca II emission lines. We find an orbital period of $P=3.601\pm0.002$ days and nearly equal radial-velocity semi-amplitudes for the two components. The system exhibits strong Ca II H and K emission, which is consistent with a BY Dra-type binary containing two similar late-G/early-K main-sequence stars, with a preliminary classification of K0V. This represents one of the first spectroscopic confirmations of a chromospherically active binary following its identification in a low-frequency radio survey.

title: Non-Perturbative Modulus Decay and Multi-Component Dark Matter
background_knowledge: 在早期宇宙学与超弦唯象学中，非热宇宙学演化历史是一个重要的研究范式。暴胀期间发生位移的标量场（如模场，moduli）会在暴胀结束后发生相干振荡，并在太初核合成（BBN）之前主导宇宙的能量密度。通常的假设是，这些模场通过引力压制的相互作用进行微扰衰变，这一早期的物质主导时期构成了预测非热弱相互作用大质量粒子（WIMP）产生、轴子暗物质、熵产生以及暗辐射丰度的基础。此外，传统模型通常倾向于假设单一的暗物质组分。然而，如果模场凝聚体在衰变过程中经历了非微扰过程（例如预加热阶段的参数共振），可能会迅速消耗模场能量，从而彻底改变原有的宇宙学图像与暗物质预测。
contribution: 本文基于适用于 $G_2$ 紧致化的有效场论，深入研究了振荡模场中非微扰的粒子产生机制。研究发现，Wino类费米子的非微扰产生在相关参数区域内受到强烈压制；但依赖于模场的轴子动能项却展现出狭窄的不稳定性带，其增长率甚至可超过哈勃膨胀率。虽然仅靠线性Floquet分析不足以确定这些不稳定性带是否会显著消耗模场凝聚体（由于宇宙膨胀、反作用和重散射等非线性效应的影响），但研究证实：传统的模场主导宇宙学图像对Wino和规范场预加热依然保持鲁棒性。然而，轴子通道提供了一种潜在的修正机制，若该非微扰产生过程足够高效，将可能改变暗物质在Wino与轴子之间的多组分比例，并提升暗辐射的丰度。
summary: Non-thermal cosmological histories rest on the assumption that scalars displaced during inflation undergo coherent oscillations, dominate the energy density of the universe before Big Bang Nucleosynthesis, and decay perturbatively through gravitationally suppressed interactions. In addition, usually a single dark matter component is assumed. This early matter-dominated era is the basis for the usual predictions of non-thermal WIMP production, axion dark matter, entropy generation, and dark radiation. This paper examines whether this picture is dynamically robust against non-perturbative decay of the modulus condensate. In this work, we study non-perturbative particle production from oscillating moduli using the effective field theory appropriate to $G_2$ compactifications. We find that non-perturbative production of Wino-like fermions is strongly suppressed in the relevant parameter regime. In contrast, a modulus-dependent axion kinetic term admits narrow instability bands with growth rates that can exceed the Hubble rate. A linear Floquet analysis alone, however, cannot determine whether these bands significantly deplete the modulus condensate, since cosmic expansion, backreaction, rescattering, and higher-order operators in the effective theory can become important. As a result, the conventional modulus-dominated cosmology remains robust against Wino and gauge-field preheating, while the axion channel provides a potentially important modification that requires nonlinear study. If sufficiently efficient, axion production can alter the division of dark matter between Winos and axions and enhance the dark-radiation abundance.

title: New Optical and Mid-Infrared RR Lyrae Period-Luminosity-Metallicity Relations for Precision Distances and Metallicity Distributions in the Magellanic Clouds
background_knowledge: 天琴座RR型变星（RR Lyrae stars）是一类短周期的脉动变星，主要分布在球状星团和星系晕等年老的恒星族群中。由于它们具有明确的“周期-光度关系”（Period-Luminosity relation），在天文学中被广泛用作“标准烛光”，是测定银河系及本星系群内天体距离的关键工具。随着Gaia卫星等提供的高精度视差数据以及多波段巡天数据的积累，天文学家能够进一步修正金属丰度对亮度的微小影响，建立更为精确的“周期-光度-金属丰度”（PLZ）关系。大、小麦哲伦云（LMC和SMC）作为距离银河系最近的矮星系，是校准宇宙距离阶梯的基石，精确测定其距离和金属丰度分布对于理解星系演化及宇宙学尺度测量具有重要意义。
contribution: 结合OGLE光学、WISE中红外测光数据与Gaia DR3高精度视差，建立了最新的天琴座RR型变星周期-光度-金属丰度（PLZ）及周期-Wesenheit-金属丰度（PWZ）经验关系，并使用当前最完整的银晕RRL光谱金属丰度星表完成校准。利用这些新关系，获得了与食双星法高度一致的大、小麦哲伦云高精度距离测量结果。同时，通过重新校准测光金属丰度关系，深入分析了麦哲伦云的金属丰度梯度，并在大麦哲伦云中首次或明确区分出两支不同的基频模式RRL恒星族群。该中红外测距关系为未来利用JWST精确测量本星系群古老恒星族群的距离提供了重要工具。
summary: RR Lyrae (RRL) stars, thanks to the existence of their period-luminosity relations, have been widely used as primary standard candles within the Milky Way and the Local Group of galaxies. We present in this work the latest empirical RRL period-luminosity-metallicity (PLZ) and period-Wesenheit-metallicity (PWZ) relations combining optical ($V, I$) and mid-infrared data ($W1$) using OGLE and WISE photometry, anchored to Gaia DR3 parallaxes. We calibrate these relations with the largest, most complete, and homogeneous catalog of Galactic halo field RRL spectroscopic metallicities. These new PLZ/PWZ relations provide distance measurements in remarkable agreement with those derived from eclipsing binaries in the Large and Small Magellanic Clouds (MC): $(m-M)_{0, LMC} = 18.47 \pm 0.07 (stat) \pm 0.05 (sys)$ mag and $(m-M)_{0, SMC} = 18.87 \pm 0.09 (stat) \pm 0.06 (sys)$ mag (within 1% and 10% of eclipsing binary distances, respectively). We have also re-calibrated photometric metallicity relations to derive individual [Fe/H] abundances of LMC and SMC RRL stars. This allowed us to investigate the metallicity gradient of the MCs and discover two distinct populations of fundamental mode RRL stars in the LMC (only one is instead found in the SMC). Our newly derived mid-infrared period-luminosity relations are poised to become an essential tool to derive precise distances of older stellar populations in the Local Group of galaxies, and can easily be adapted to observations obtained in JWST NIRCam photometric bands.

title: Laboratory Evidence that Methanol-Rich Ice Mantles Lower Methyl Formate Binding Energies
background_knowledge: 在星际介质和恒星形成区中，星际尘埃颗粒表面通常包裹着一层主要由水（H2O）、甲醇（CH3OH）等分子组成的冰幔。天体化学模型认为，复杂的有机分子（COMs，如甲酸甲酯，是生命前体分子的重要组成部分）主要在这些极其寒冷的冰幔中通过表面化学反应形成。随着原恒星的演化并加热周围环境，冰幔中的分子会发生热解吸（升华）进入气相。传统范式假设，由于水冰是冰幔的主要成分，COMs的释放通常受控于水冰基质的升华过程（特征温度约100K）。然而，近年来的射电天文观测发现，在远低于100K的冷暗环境中就已经存在大量气相的复杂有机分子，这一现象与传统的水冰捕获与共解吸理论产生了矛盾，促使研究人员重新审视不同冰基质成分（如富含甲醇的冰层）对分子结合能和解吸动力学的影响。
contribution: 本文通过实验室程序升温解吸测量技术，量化了甲酸甲酯（MF）在四种天体物理相关基底（无定形/结晶态的水冰和甲醇冰）上的解吸动力学。研究发现，MF与甲醇冰的结合能（无定形约5469K，结晶态约5333K）显著弱于与水冰的结合能（无定形约6247K，结晶态约6213K）。甲醇冰表面的弱结合、增强的表面迁移率以及较低的捕获效率，使得MF在甲醇冰上的特征解吸温度降至约85K（水冰上为95-100K）。这一实验证据自然地解释了天文观测中气相MF在低温下提前出现的现象，并提出了一种两步热解吸物理图像：即与富甲醇冰幔结合的MF可以在主体水冰升华之前被提前释放到星际介质中。
summary: Complex organic molecules are widely detected in star-forming regions and are important precursors to prebiotic species. Because these molecules are thought to form primarily within icy grain mantles, their desorption is assumed to be regulated by the sublimation of the surrounding H$_2$O ice matrix. However, observations increasingly reveal gas-phase abundances of methyl formate (MF) at temperatures well below the sublimation temperature of water ice (T ~ 100K), challenging this view. To investigate how ice composition and phase influence MF desorption, we present laboratory temperature-programmed desorption measurements of MF from four astrophysically relevant substrates: amorphous and crystalline H$_2$O and CH$_3$OH. Desorption kinetics were analyzed using pre-exponential factors derived from transition-state theory with leading-edge analysis and non-negative least-squares inversion to recover binding-energy distributions. We find that MF binds more weakly to CH$_3$OH ice than to H$_2$O-rich substrates, with representative binding energies of ~6247K for amorphous H$_2$O, ~6213K for crystalline H$_2$O, and ~5469K for amorphous CH$_3$OH. MF deposited on crystalline CH$_3$OH exhibits coverage-independent leading edges consistent with multilayer or island desorption, yielding an effective binding energy of 5333K. Enhanced surface mobility and reduced trapping efficiency on methanol ice, combined with weaker MF binding, provide a natural explanation for the early appearance of gas-phase MF observed in star-forming environments, with characteristic desorption temperatures of ~85K on CH$_3$OH and ~95-100K on H$_2$O. Together, these effects support a two-step thermal desorption pathway in which MF associated with CH$_3$OH-rich ice can be released prior to bulk H$_2$O sublimation.

title: Entropy applications in cosmology: spacetime thermodynamics, holographic dark energy, entropic gravity and beyond - a review
background_knowledge: 在现代理论物理和宇宙学中，熵（Entropy）已成为连接引力、量子理论和热力学的核心概念。自物理学家提出黑洞热力学（即黑洞的熵与其事件视界面积成正比）以来，学界逐渐认识到时空本身可能具有微观结构与热力学属性。这一认知催生了全息原理（Holographic Principle），即一个空间区域的自由度受限于其边界的面积。在宇宙学框架下，研究者尝试将热力学定律推广至宇宙视界，以探索引力动力学的起源（如将引力视为一种演生现象或熵力），或通过全息熵界限来约束宇宙的真空能（如全息暗能量模型），从而为理解宇宙演化与量子引力提供统一的热力学与信息学视角。
contribution: 本文系统综述了熵在引力与宇宙学语境下的应用。作者首先回顾了黑洞热力学、熵界、全息原理及面积定律，并探讨了量子场论、广义不确定性原理和修正引力理论对熵的修正。随后，论文重点讨论了熵在宇宙学中的三种核心应用：1）时空热力学猜想，即引力动力学可由宇宙视界的热力学关系推导，且广义熵会导致修正的宇宙演化；2）全息方法，即利用熵界约束宇宙真空能，从而构建全息暗能量模型及其推广；3）熵力引力，即将引力解释为熵起源的演生现象及其宇宙学唯象学。该综述厘清了熵在理论框架中的作用，探讨了当前的未解之谜，并为在热力学和信息学层面上深入理解引力与宇宙学指明了方向。
summary: Entropy has emerged as a key concept at the intersection of gravity, quantum theory, and cosmology, revealing deep connections between geometry, information, and thermodynamics. The realization that black holes are thermodynamic systems, characterized by an entropy proportional to their horizon area, has provided evidence that spacetime itself may possess a microscopic structure. Since then, entropy has acquired a central role across quantum field theory, holography, quantum gravity, and cosmology. In this review, we present a unified account of entropy in gravitational and cosmological contexts. We first survey entropy in gravitational systems, focusing on black-hole thermodynamics, entropy bounds, the holographic principle, entanglement entropy, and the area law, together with the main corrections and generalizations arising from quantum field theory, generalized uncertainty principles, modified statistics, and extended theories of gravity. We then discuss three conceptually distinct ways in which entropy is employed in cosmology. The first is through the spacetime-thermodynamics conjecture, in which gravitational dynamics emerge from thermodynamic relations applied to cosmological horizons, and generalized entropy forms consequently lead to modified cosmological evolution. The second is the holographic approach, in which entropy bounds constrain the vacuum energy of the Universe, giving rise to the holographic dark energy scenario and its various extensions. The third is entropic gravity, where gravity is interpreted as an emergent phenomenon of entropic origin, leading to interesting cosmological phenomenology. By reviewing the theoretical foundations and cosmological implications of these entropic frameworks, we aim to clarify the role of entropy, discuss open issues and outline directions toward a deeper thermodynamic and informational understanding of gravity and cosmology.

title: The Simons Observatory: Commissioning of the Mid-Frequency Small Aperture Telescopes
background_knowledge: 宇宙微波背景辐射（CMB）是宇宙大爆炸遗留下来的热辐射，被称为宇宙学的“第一缕曙光”。在宇宙极早期的暴胀（Inflation）阶段可能会产生原初引力波，这些引力波会在CMB的偏振场中留下特殊的旋涡状印记，即大角尺度的B模式偏振（B-mode polarization）。探测这种极其微弱的B模式偏振是当前基础物理与早期宇宙学最前沿的课题之一，它将为暴胀理论提供决定性的观测证据。为实现这一目标，新一代的CMB观测实验（如西蒙斯天文台，Simons Observatory）通常采用大规模的超导转变边缘传感器（TES）阵列以及专门针对大角尺度观测优化的小口径望远镜（SAT）来获取极高的探测灵敏度。
contribution: 本文报告了智利西蒙斯天文台（Simons Observatory）首批两台中频小口径望远镜（MF SATs，覆盖90 GHz和150 GHz频段）于2023年底开始的调试观测结果。该设备专为搜寻CMB大角尺度B模式偏振中的原初引力波信号而设计。调试结果显示，每台望远镜在典型的1毫米可降水量条件下成功运行了约9400个转变边缘传感器（TES），良率达80%。通过对行星的观测成功验证了望远镜的光学性能并校准了仪器响应，端到端的光学效率与模型预期一致。在标称观测条件下，两台望远镜组合后的噪声等效温度在90 GHz和150 GHz频段分别达到了2.4 μK_CMB√s 和 3.2 μK_CMB√s，这一表现显著优于天文台基线设计的瞬时灵敏度目标。
summary: The Simons Observatory (SO) is a cosmic microwave background (CMB) survey experiment observing from an altitude of 5,200 m in the Atacama Desert in Chile. The SO Small Aperture Telescopes (SATs) will cover six spectral bands between 30 and 280 GHz primarily to search for evidence of primordial gravitational waves in the large angular scale $B$-modes of the CMB polarization. The first two Mid-Frequency (MF) SATs, operating in the 90 and 150 GHz frequency bands, began commissioning observations in late 2023, and we present the results of those observations here. Each MF SAT operates with approximately 9,400 biased transition-edge sensors (TES) at 1 mm of precipitable water vapor (PWV), representing a typical 80% yield. Planet observations confirm the telescope optics performance, calibrate the instrument response, and measure the end-to-end optical efficiency of the SATs. The realized instrument efficiencies are within the range expected based on instrument model predictions. In nominal observing conditions, the noise equivalent temperatures from both telescopes combined are $2.4~\mathrm{μK_{CMB}\sqrt{s}}$ at 90 GHz and $3.2~\mathrm{μK_{CMB}\sqrt{s}}$ at 150 GHz, substantially outperforming the baseline instantaneous sensitivity targets for the observatory.

title: Probing magnetic correlations in anisotropic turbulence
background_knowledge: 磁流体力学（MHD）湍流广泛存在于宇宙等离子体环境中，从大尺度的宇宙纤维网（filamentary structures）到早期宇宙可能存在的宇宙弦（cosmic strings），都伴随着复杂的磁场演化。在湍流场中，往往会自发形成具有一定空间关联和寿命的“相干结构”（coherent structures）。理解这些磁场结构的拓扑特征、空间尺度及其统计性质（如高斯分布与非高斯重尾分布），对于研究带电粒子（如重子、轻子、宇宙线等）在磁场中的散射、捕获与加速机制，以及早期宇宙物质密度的不均匀性演化具有重要的物理意义。
contribution: 本文利用SO(3)和SO(2)旋转群的不可约表示，对磁流体湍流中相干结构的拓扑分类进行了研究，并探讨了宇宙中（如纤维状结构和宇宙弦周围）轴对称磁场附近的相干结构。研究对比了高斯与非高斯磁场分布，发现两者会产生不同的相干结构：高斯结构中粒子的散射主要依赖于两个长度尺度，而在非高斯分布下则存在第三个类似于泰勒尺度的中间长度尺度。研究还发现，两种情况下极化各向异性均占据主导，表明磁场梯度被迫形成刚性的空间构型。在早期宇宙中，这些特性会改变重子和轻子的平均自由程；非高斯（重尾）分布的磁场会使带电粒子的捕获与加速更加频繁，进而由磁场的分布特性直接决定了这些结构附近密度不均匀性的长度尺度。
summary: The topological classes of coherent structures in magnetohydrodynamic turbulence are studied using the irreducible representations of the SO(3) and SO(2) rotation groups. We probe the coherent structures around axisymmetric magnetic fields in the universe. Such axisymmetric fields can be found around filamentary structures as well as cosmic strings. We have considered a Gaussian and a non Gaussian magnetic field. We find that the field distribution leads to different coherent structures for the two cases. Our results show that the scattering of particles from the Gaussian structure depends predominantly on two lengthscales. In the case of the non Gaussian distribution, we can define a third intermediate lengthscale, similar to the Taylor lengthscale. In both the cases, we find that there is a dominance of the polarization anisotropy which indicates that the field gradients are forced into rigid spatial configurations. In the early universe, this will change the mean free path of the baryons and leptons in the coherent structures. Trapping of charged particle as well as their acceleration will be more frequent in the case of a magnetic field with a heavy tailed distribution. The lengthscale of density inhomogeneities close to these structures will thus be determined by the magnetic field distribution of the fields.

title: A sub-100 pc view at z~5 of a Multiply-Imaged Massive Quiescent Galaxy
background_knowledge: 在星系形成与演化领域，早期宇宙（高红移）中大质量宁静星系的形成与演化机制一直是天体物理学的重大前沿问题。理论模型通常认为，这些星系在经历了早期极其剧烈且高效的重子物质转化为恒星的过程后，恒星形成活动会突然停止，这一过程被称为“猝灭”（Quenching）。为了解释这种快速猝灭，主流物理图像常诉诸于“中心致密化”（Compaction，即气体高度集中导致核区剧烈星暴而后耗尽气体）或活动星系核（AGN）的强烈反馈。然而，由于高红移星系距离极其遥远，常规的场星系观测受限于望远镜的分辨率极限，往往只能得到致密且无法分辨内部结构的图像，难以在观测上真正区分致密化驱动猝灭与星系的长期演化。引力透镜效应作为宇宙的“天然望远镜”，能有效放大背景天体并显著提升空间分辨率，是解析高红移星系内部精细结构并检验上述猝灭模型的关键手段。
contribution: 本文结合詹姆斯·韦伯空间望远镜（JWST）观测与强引力透镜效应，对红移 z=5.18 的大质量后星暴星系 VENUS-CLJ0152-QG1 实现了物理分辨率高达 70 pc（比JWST基本模糊极限提升约7倍）的二维结构解析。研究发现，该星系的半光半径比预期大两倍，中心恒星质量面密度比同类场星系低半个量级（0.5 dex），且存在偏离中心的电离气体发射。这些精细的结构特征表明，该星系在没有经历中心致密化事件或明显的 AGN 活动的情况下，就突然停止了恒星形成。这一发现指出，过去受限于分辨率的观测可能普遍高估了早期星系的整体密度，同时挑战了现有模型，表明宇宙早期大质量星系的猝灭需要不依赖于致密化和无遮蔽 AGN 的替代物理机制。
summary: Recent James Webb Space Telescope spectroscopic surveys reveal an abundance of rapidly assembled early galaxies in the first billion years. Cosmological simulations struggle to reproduce this population because models require a rapid, highly efficient conversion of baryons into stars followed by an abrupt cessation of star-formation, known as quenching, in the early Universe. Testing these theoretical models remains difficult because high-redshift field galaxies appear compact and unresolved. This lack of resolution makes it impossible to distinguish compaction-driven quenching from secular evolution. Here we present VENUS-CLJ0152-QG1, a massive post-starburst galaxy at $z=5.18\pm0.15$, with inferred low-levels of star-formation in the last 30 Myr. The foreground cluster CL J0152.7-1357 gravitationally lenses the system into three images with median magnifications of $μ\sim$ 7, 11, and 0.6. This geometry yields a physical resolution of $\sim 70$ pc, a factor of $\sim 7$ better than the JWST/NIRCam fundamental blurring limit (full-width half-maximum of $\sim$0.48 kpc at $z\sim5$). Our two-dimensional mapping reveals a half-light radius twice as large as expected, a central stellar mass surface density half a dex lower than field analogs, and off-center ionized gas emission. Together, these features show that VENUS-CLJ0152-QG1 abruptly ceased star formation in the absence of a compaction event or an obvious active galactic nucleus. Consequently, this galaxy shows that unresolved observations likely overestimate the global densities of early galaxies, and that theoretical models require alternative pathways to quench massive sources without relying on compaction or unobscured AGN.

title: Differentiable astrophysics at scale: solving and differentiating ODE ensembles on the GPU
background_knowledge: 在现代天体物理学中，研究人员越来越多地采用基于梯度的统计推断方法（如哈密顿蒙特卡洛方法，HMC）来进行模型拟合与参数估计。这些方法不仅需要正向模拟物理过程，还需要高效计算物理模型相对于其参数的导数。然而，许多天体物理场景（如星系势场中的恒星轨道动力学、宇宙膨胀历史演化、双黑洞自旋进动等）的模型预测都依赖于求解常微分方程组（ODE）。在实际的参数空间探索中，往往需要针对成千上万甚至数以百万计的参数组合重复求解这些ODE。这种大规模的‘ODE系综’（ODE ensembles）积分计算通常会成为整个数据分析过程中的算力瓶颈。传统的CPU串行或多核计算在处理此类需求时效率受限，而利用GPU等硬件加速器结合自动微分技术（Differentiable Programming）则是突破该算力瓶颈、实现大规模复杂物理模型推断的前沿研究范式。
contribution: 本文开发并向天文社区引入了GRADSOLVE——一个基于JAX框架的开源GPU计算库，旨在极大地加速ODE系综的求解与求导过程。该工具将每个系综成员的计算分配到独立的GPU线程中，允许各自采用独立的步长，并在单次计算传递中同时返回积分结果及其对参数的导数。研究团队在银河系恒星轨道、暗能量宇宙学膨胀历史以及双黑洞自旋进动三个不同领域的问题上进行了等精度基准测试。结果表明，在处理一百万个参数集（轨迹）时，GRADSOLVE的运行速度比满载128核的CPU并行代码快8.5至1500倍，且在同一GPU环境下比JAX生态中最先进的ODE库（DIFFRAX）快11至15倍。该工作将百万量级的微分方程组积分及求导耗时压缩至秒级，使得大规模的基于梯度的天体物理分析成为常规可行的手段。
summary: Astronomers increasingly fit their models with gradient-based methods, such as Hamiltonian Monte Carlo, which need the derivatives of the model with respect to its parameters. In many analyses a prediction requires solving a small system of ordinary differential equations (ODEs) for thousands to millions of parameter sets, and this ensemble of integrations often sets the cost of the analysis. We introduce to the astronomical community GRADSOLVE, a JAX library that moves this computation to graphics processing units (GPUs): it integrates each member of the ensemble in its own GPU thread with its own step size and returns the derivatives with respect to the parameters in the same pass. We measure the speed-up it provides in three examples from different fields of astronomy, stellar orbits in the Galactic potential, the expansion history of a dark-energy cosmology and the spin precession of binary black holes, with every code held to the same accuracy requirement. For a million trajectories GRADSOLVE runs 8.5 to 1500 times faster than the serial CPU code of each example running on all 128 cores of a CPU, and several orders of magnitude faster than on one core. On the same GPU it is also 11 to 15 times faster than DIFFRAX, the state-of-the-art ODE library in JAX, in all three examples. With GRADSOLVE a million such integrations take seconds or less on one GPU, so gradient-based analyses that need ensembles of this size become routine. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/ECLIPSE-AI4Science/gradsolve.

title: Investigating the ionization mechanisms powering the extreme emission lines in metal-poor galaxies
background_knowledge: 极低金属丰度的极端发射线星系（EEMPGs）由于其物理条件与宇宙再电离时期的初代星系高度相似，被视为研究早期宇宙星系极端物理环境和电离辐射场的理想‘本地实验室’。在这些星系的光谱中，经常观测到需要极高能量光子（> 54 eV）才能激发的极高电离态发射线（例如He II 甚至 [Ne V]）。然而，产生这些高能电离光子的主导物理机制长期以来存在争议。潜在的候选机制包括中等质量黑洞（IMBHs）的吸积活动、超亮X射线源（ULXs）以及由极端恒星形成或星风驱动的辐射激波。为了区分这些复杂的机制，天文学家通常利用跨波段（光学至中红外）的低电离与高电离发射线强度比诊断图（Diagnostic Diagrams），结合光子能量收支模型的定量计算，来反演和限制主导星系光谱特征的核心电离源。
contribution: 本研究选取了11个具有JWST/MIRI观测数据的极低金属丰度极端发射线星系（金属丰度不到太阳的20%）作为样本，旨在揭示驱动其高电离发射线的主导机制。研究在所有样本中均探测到了He II λ4686发射线，并在更广泛的本地EEMPGs样本中探测到42%具有[Ne V] 14.3 μm发射线。多波段诊断图分析表明，这些星系位于通常由活动星系核（AGN）占据的区域或恒星形成与AGN的过渡区。通过对发射线所需能量收支的严格评估，作者发现单纯的辐射激波和超亮X射线源（ULXs）无法提供足够的高能光子。最终结果表明，这些高电离线的最可能电离源是主导性的恒星辐射（恒星形成活动）与中等质量黑洞（IMBH）的少量贡献（4%-8%）的组合，成功解释了观测到的高能光子预算与发射线通量比。
summary: Extreme emission metal-poor galaxies (EEMPGs) are excellent local laboratories for understanding the extreme physical conditions and ionizing radiation fields in the early Universe. However, the exact source of high-ionization emission lines in them, whether from intermediate-mass black holes (IMBHs), ultra-luminous X-ray sources (ULXs), or radiative shocks, remains debated. We characterize the fundamental properties and ionizing radiation field on metal-poor EEMPGs, aiming to identify the dominant sources of the highly ionizing photons that drive these lines. We selected a sample of 11 EEMPGs, among the most metal-poor galaxies with JWST/MIRI observations known so far (12+log(O/H) < 8.0, or Z/Z$_\odot$ < 20%). Using optical and IR diagnostic diagrams for ions of both high and low ionization potential, we constrain the ionization source dominating their spectral features. We detect high-ionization lines, notably He II$λ$4686 in all galaxies and [Ne V] 14.3 $μ$m in 42% of a broader sample of local EEMPGs. The multi-wavelength diagnostic diagrams reveal that our EEMPGs are located in areas that normally are occupied by active galactic nuclei (AGNs) or between the star-formation and AGN sequences. Evaluating the energetics required to produce these lines, we find that radiative shocks and ULXs are not sufficient. Instead, our analysis suggests that a combination of sources with star-formation and a small contribution from an IMBH provide enough high-energy photon budget to explain the emission lines of ions with high-ionization potentials (> 54 eV). Our EEMPG sample, covering various properties, is ideal for studying the first galaxies. Their flux ratios of low- and high-ionization lines suggest stellar radiation as the likely ionization source, with a small contribution from an IMBH (4-8%). Pure shocks fail to explain the observed emission line ratios and ionizing photon budget.

title: Neural Network Guided Parameter Space Constraints for Gravitational Wave Searches from Binary Black Holes
background_knowledge: 引力波（Gravitational Waves）是由致密双星（如双黑洞、双中子星）并合等剧烈天体物理过程产生的时空涟漪。当前主流的引力波信号搜寻技术依赖于“匹配滤波”（Matched Filtering），即将干涉仪（如LIGO）收集到的强噪声数据与海量的理论波形模板库进行互相关运算。由于双星系统的内禀参数（如质量、自旋）构成了高维参数空间，为了保证搜寻的灵敏度，模板库需要覆盖极其密集的参数网格，这导致了极高的计算资源消耗。近年来，随着人工智能的发展，研究人员开始引入卷积神经网络（CNN）等深度学习技术，旨在快速从噪声中识别信号，并初步圈定可能产生该信号的参数空间范围，从而大幅降低传统匹配滤波的盲搜范围和计算开销。
contribution: 本文将前期基于卷积神经网络（CNN）的引力波搜寻框架扩展至具有共线自旋（aligned-spin）的双黑洞（BBH）系统，并深入探究了不同的参数空间表象对CNN划定参数子区（patch identification）准确率的影响。研究证实，仅利用现有共线自旋模板库训练的CNN，即可在独立的均匀采样测试集上实现逾99.8%的信噪分类准确率，表明无需额外生成均匀采样训练集。此外，作者利用主成分分析（PCA）将模板库划分为四个均衡子区，并评估了五种参数表象的分类效果。结果表明，“啁啾质量-持续时间”（chirp mass-duration）表象取得了最高的平均识别准确率（93.2%），显著优于传统的后牛顿展开坐标。该研究证明现有模板库已足以支持高精度机器学习模型的训练，且指出恰当的参数空间表象对于有效约束信号参数至关重要。
summary: The detection of gravitational waves (GWs) from compact binary coalescences (CBCs) using matched filtering is computationally demanding because detector data must be correlated with many template waveforms spanning a high-dimensional intrinsic parameter space. In our previous work, we showed that a convolutional neural network (CNN) can classify noisy signals against pure noise and constrain the intrinsic parameter space of a true non-spinning binary black hole (BBH) signal, enabling a narrower matched-filter search region and reducing computational cost. Here, we extend this framework to aligned-spin BBH systems and investigate how different parameter-space representations affect CNN-based patch identification. Using IMRPhenomD waveforms over the aligned-spin BBH parameter space and Advanced LIGO design sensitivity, we show that a CNN trained solely on the aligned-spin template bank achieves more than 99.8% signal-noise classification accuracy on independently generated uniformly sampled BBH signals, indicating that additional uniformly sampled training data are unnecessary. We partition the template bank into four approximately balanced patches using a Principal Component Analysis (PCA)-based quantile scheme and evaluate five parameter-space representations for patch identification. The chirp mass-duration representation achieves the highest average accuracy (93.2%), followed by chirp mass (91.6%) and component masses (90.5%). The post-Newtonian coordinates tau_0-tau_3 and theta_0-theta_3-theta_3s yield substantially lower accuracies. These results show that the existing template bank is sufficient for training and high-accuracy signal detection, while the choice of parameter-space representation is critical for constraining the parameters of the true signal.

title: The Neutral Hydrogen Gas Content of Star-forming and Quiescent S0 Galaxies
background_knowledge: 在哈勃星系形态分类中，透镜状星系（S0星系）介于椭圆星系和螺旋星系之间。它们通常具有中央核球和星系盘，但缺乏明显的旋臂结构。传统物理图像认为，S0星系是已经耗尽气体、停止恒星形成的“宁静”（Quiescent）早期型星系。然而，近期观测表明，部分S0星系依然保持着活跃的恒星形成活动。中性氢（HI）和分子气体是星系孕育新恒星的原料库，通过射电波段测量其气体丰度和消耗时标，可以直观反映星系的恒星形成潜力与演化状态。探讨处于不同恒星形成状态的S0星系与螺旋星系之间的物理差异和演化联系（如形态淬灭、气体吸积或星系并合），是揭示星系演化路径的关键课题。
contribution: 本文利用MaNGA巡天样本，对比研究了恒星形成S0星系（SFS0s）、宁静S0星系（qS0s）与恒星形成螺旋星系的气体丰度。研究发现，SFS0s的HI质量分数、HI缺陷度和分子气体比例均介于qS0s和螺旋星系之间，且其气体消耗时标与螺旋星系相似，远短于qS0s。总重子质量比较揭示SFS0s的质量显著低于qS0s，证明两者属于不同的演化群体：SFS0s可能由低质量前身星系吸积气体或失去旋臂演化而来，而大质量qS0s则是褪色或经历合并的螺旋星系的产物，两者之间不存在互相转化或演化的直接联系。
summary: Lenticular (or S0) galaxies that remain actively star-forming (SFS0s) are a unique transition population among galaxies. We investigated the HI (21cm) neutral hydrogen content of a sample of lenticular galaxies identified from within the Mapping Nearby Galaxies at Apache Point Observatory (MaNGA) survey and which have been classified as star-forming or quiescent (qS0s). We compared these populations to each other and to a sample of star-forming spiral galaxies in MaNGA. We found that the HI Mass fraction and HI Deficiency of the SFS0s were intermediate between the quiescent S0s and the star-forming spirals, but most similar to the spirals. The HI depletion times of the quiescent S0's is very much longer than that of the SFS0 and spirals, which have roughly similar times. We also compared the molecular gas fractions of the three groups which shows that the lowest fraction of the three populations, followed by the star-forming S0s and then the star-forming spirals. A comparison of total baryonic mass comparisons indicates that the star-forming S0s have significantly lower masses than the qS0s in the sample. This suggests that the star-forming S0s must form from lower-mass progenitors (unobserved by MaNGA) which either accrete external gas, or loose spiral arms. The more massive quiescent S0s are a completely separate population, most likely to be formed either from fading star-forming spirals or from medium- to high-mass spirals undergoing mergers. The SFS0s in this sample cannot form from the quiescent S0s in this sample that receive in-falling gas, nor can they fade to create these qS0s.

title: Cavity-driven Gas Transport in Cool-Core Clusters: Implications for Multiphase Gas Cooling
background_knowledge: 在“冷芯”（cool-core）星系团中心，星系团内介质（ICM）的X射线辐射冷却时间通常短于宇宙年龄，理应导致大规模的冷却流并触发剧烈的恒星形成。然而，实际观测到的冷气体和新诞生恒星远低于理论预期，这就是著名的“冷却流问题”。目前广为接受的物理图像是活动星系核（AGN）反馈机制：中心最亮星系团星系（BCG）内的超大质量黑洞喷流在高温等离子体中吹出巨大的X射线空洞（cavities）。这些空洞在浮力作用下向外上升时，不仅能通过耗散机械功加热星系团大气，还会像气泡一样将中心区域低熵、高密度的热气体向外提升（uplift）。这些被提升的低熵气体在更大半径处容易发生局部热不稳定性，进而冷却凝结成多相气体（如Hα发射线气体和冷分子气体），从而维持了星系团核心的加热与冷却动态平衡。
contribution: 本研究基于24个冷芯星系团样本，定量分析了X射线空洞驱动的气体提升参数空间（包括提升质量、速度、半径和冷却时间），并评估了其在分子气体形成中的作用。研究发现，观测到的分子气体质量与空洞提升的最大热气体质量呈近似线性关系；冷却时间在数亿年的气体能以150-400 km/s的特征速度被输运至10-30 kpc的典型Hα纤维状结构半径处。通过对比当前空洞寿命内的预期冷却质量与实际分子气体储量，作者指出分子气体的积累可能是通过多次AGN反馈周期（即重复的气体提升与冷却过程）完成的。该结果证实了AGN爆发通过气体提升促进低熵气体凝结，进而帮助在冷芯最亮星系团星系（BCG）中构建分子气体储库的物理图景。
summary: We present a study of gas uplift by cavities and its role in promoting the formation of molecular gas in cool-core galaxy clusters. Using a sample of 24 clusters, we quantify the parameter space of gas uplift, including lifting masses, velocities, radii, and cooling times, and compare the displaced hot gas to observed molecular gas masses. Almost all clusters contain sufficient low-entropy gas within the central $\sim$10 kpc to account for the observed molecular gas. The molecular gas mass scales approximately linearly with the maximum gas mass displaced by cavities. Gas with cooling times of a few $10^8$ yr can be transported to typical H$α$ filament radii of 10--30 kpc at characteristic velocities of 150--400 km s$^{-1}$, whereas gas with $t_{\rm cool}\sim10^9$ yr generally requires uplift to $\gtrsim60$ kpc. The mass expected to cool over the lifetimes of the currently observed cavities is comparable to the molecular reservoir in several systems, assuming that 50\% of the displaced gas mass is lifted and cools, whereas other systems contain excess molecular gas. This suggests that the molecular gas reservoirs may have accumulated over multiple AGN feedback cycles involving repeated gas uplift and cooling, or through additional processes. H$α$ and infrared luminosities increase linearly with X-ray cooling luminosity, linking the multiphase emission to the cooling atmosphere. Overall, our results support a picture in which repeated AGN outbursts with gas uplift promote the condensation of low-entropy gas and help build molecular reservoirs in cool-core BCGs.

title: The universe as a superconductor: How to search for a photon mass
background_knowledge: 在粒子物理标准模型中，光子被认为是无质量的规范玻色子，负责传递长程的电磁相互作用。然而，许多超越标准模型的理论允许光子具有微小的非零质量。光子获得质量的物理机制主要有两种：普罗卡（Proca）机制（直接在拉格朗日量中引入质量项）或阿贝尔·希格斯（Abelian Higgs）机制（通过标量场的自发对称性破缺赋予光子质量）。在希格斯机制下，宇宙可以被类比为一个巨大的超导体，光子在其中获得有效质量（类似于超导现象中的迈斯纳效应）。由于此机制中的希格斯场通常带有微小电荷且质量极轻，系统的状态（如处于迈斯纳相、涡旋相或对称性恢复相）会高度依赖于环境中的背景磁场。这意味着，在不同的天体物理环境或实验室条件下，光子表现出的质量特征可能是动态变化而非固定不变的。
contribution: 本文重新评估了基于阿贝尔·希格斯机制（而非普罗卡项）产生的光子质量上限。作者指出，实验所测得的光子质量取决于其所处的磁场环境，并据此将现有实验类比为第一类和第二类超导体进行分类。对于第一类光子质量，星系和星系际介质中的磁场足以使对称性恢复，这允许真空光子质量高达 0.3 MeV；宇宙中可能存在光子质量高达 10^{-5} eV 的区域，可通过观测频率相关的光学深度来探测。对于第二类光子质量，作者通过将磁流体力学推广至非零光子质量的情况，发现最强的物理限制来自于“星系发电机必须能产生观测到的星系磁场”这一条件。研究还强调，由于地球磁场足以在大部分剩余参数空间中恢复对称性，未来的实验室探测必须在大型磁屏蔽室内或太空中进行。此外，对遥远光源（尤其是快速射电暴 FRB）的观测，为探测地球实验室无法触及的参数空间提供了独特的灵敏度。
summary: We revisit the bounds on the photon mass when it arises from an Abelian Higgs mechanism rather than a Proca term. Because the higgs is necessarily millicharged and light, the phase of the theory (Meissner, vortex, or symmetry-restored) depends on the ambient magnetic field, so the photon mass an experiment measures depends on the environment it is performed in. We classify existing experiments by the phases in which they apply, in analogy with Type I and Type II superconductors. For Type I photon masses, magnetic fields in galaxies and the intergalactic medium can restore the symmetry everywhere, allowing a vacuum photon mass as large as $0.3 \,{\rm MeV}$. Regions of photon mass as large as $10^{-5}\, {\rm eV}$ could be present in the Universe, and measurement of frequency dependent optical depth can potentially reveal these regions. For Type II photon masses, we show that the strongest constraints mainly arise from the requirement that the galactic dynamo generates the observed magnetic fields, which we derive by generalizing magnetohydrodynamics to a nonzero photon mass. Since the terrestrial magnetic field restores the symmetry in much of the remaining parameter space, laboratory searches performed inside large magnetically shielded volumes, or in space, could probe photon masses invisible to any experiment on Earth. Measurements of distant light sources, in particular, fast radio bursts, also offer unique sensitivity to parameters invisible to lab experiments.

title: Correcting for Evidence Uncertainty in the Templated Background Search for the Stochastic Gravitational-Wave Background
background_knowledge: 随机引力波背景（Stochastic Gravitational-Wave Background, SGWB）是由宇宙演化历史中大量无法被探测器单独分辨的引力波事件（如双黑洞、双中子星并合等天体物理过程，或极早期宇宙的物理过程）相互叠加形成的随机背景信号。为了从探测器强大的背景噪声中提取出微弱的天体物理SGWB信号，研究人员常采用贝叶斯模板化背景搜索（Templated Background Search, TBS）方法。该范式将海量连续的观测数据分割成大量较短的片段，结合已知的引力波波形模板，利用嵌套采样（Nested Sampling）等数值算法计算每个数据片段包含信号的贝叶斯证据。当对数以百万计的数据片段进行综合推断以提取整体物理参数（如事件的发生率或占空比）时，算法对底层证据估算的精度及其统计波动极其敏感。
contribution: 揭示了在寻找天体物理随机引力波背景的贝叶斯模板化背景搜索（TBS）中存在一种新的系统性偏差：片段级嵌套采样证据估计的统计不确定性在大量累积后，会导致推断的信号占空比被错误地高估达一个数量级。论文提出了一种简单高效的校正方法以消除该偏差，同时发现合理的搜索先验设计（既要避免仅限高信噪比导致中等信号被误判，又要防止过度支持弱信号放大证据不确定性）与该校正方法同等重要，二者均为未来大规模观测数据实现鲁棒贝叶斯推断的关键。
summary: We report a new source of systematic bias in the Bayesian Templated Background Search (TBS) for the astrophysical stochastic gravitational-wave background. This bias arises from the statistical uncertainty in nested sampling evidence estimates at the segment level and persists even when the likelihood model accurately characterizes the data. Using an analytically tractable model and a frequency-domain mock data analysis with an astrophysically motivated binary black hole population, we show that this uncertainty coherently inflates the inferred duty cycle by up to an order of magnitude when millions of segments are accumulated. We propose a simple and efficient correction and demonstrate its effectiveness across all tested configurations. We also find that a search prior restricted to high optimal signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) misattributes intermediate-strength signals, while extending the prior to support weaker signals amplifies the evidence uncertainty. Both the correction and careful search prior design are essential for robust inference as TBS analyses scale to upcoming observing runs.

title: Sequential Star-Formation and the Near-Infrared Stellar Populations within N159
background_knowledge: 恒星形成通常发生在星际介质中的巨分子云内。大质量恒星的剧烈活动（如强烈的紫外辐射和恒星风）会电离周围气体形成H II区，同时可能压缩邻近的气体分子云，从而在不同空间位置依次触发新一代恒星的诞生，这一机制被称为“次序恒星形成”（Sequential Star Formation）。处于形成早期的年轻星体对象（YSOs）通常被厚重的母体尘埃云包裹，在光学波段极难被直接观测。因此，天文学家通常利用红外观测来穿透尘埃遮蔽，通过探测星周盘或包层产生的红外辐射过剩，以及吸积过程产生的特定发射线（如帕邢-α线）来证认和研究这些年轻天体。詹姆斯·韦伯空间望远镜（JWST）凭借其卓越的近中红外灵敏度和极高的空间分辨率，使得在邻近星系（如大麦哲伦云LMC）中直接分辨极低质量恒星（亚太阳质量量级）并详细描绘复杂恒星形成历史成为可能。
contribution: 本文基于JWST/NIRCam对大麦哲伦云（LMC）中著名且富含H II区的恒星形成区N159进行了首次多波段红外测光研究。研究团队利用10个近红外滤光片（覆盖1-4.7微米）提取了超过30万个点源的数据，探测极限深达~27等（对应恒星质量低至~0.1太阳质量以下）。通过构建多重颜色-星等和颜色-颜色图，研究成功分离了主序星、老年恒星与年龄小于0.5 Myr的年轻星族。在年轻星族中，作者通过Pa-α辐射过剩和强红外过剩特征，证认了正在吸积的前主序星及候选年轻星体（YSOs），并发现了一个具有水冰吸收特征的子星族。空间分布分析表明，候选YSO与尘埃纤维结构及分子气体高度空间相关（证实其处于深埋状态），且N159E区域的星族演化阶段晚于N159W区域，为该区域的大尺度次序恒星形成模型提供了决定性的观测支持。
summary: We present the first results from a JWST/NIRCam study of the star-forming region N159, one of the richest H II complexes in the Large Magellanic Cloud. This region stretches over $\sim$130 pc, and exemplifies large-scale sequential star formation. We present photometric results of $>$300,000 point sources combining data from ten near-infrared JWST filters spanning 1-4.7 microns. We detect sources as faint as $\sim$27 magnitudes at F115W, corresponding to stellar masses reaching below $\sim$0.1 $M_{\odot}$. By constructing several color-magnitude and color-color diagrams, we separate young stars from main-sequence and older stars within N159, finding evidence for stellar populations younger than 0.5 Myr. Of the young population, we identify accreting, pre-main sequence stars from their Paschen-$α$ (Pa$α$) excess and a population of sources bearing strong infrared (IR) excess, representing candidate young stellar objects (YSOs). Within this population, we identify a subpopulation of sources with H$_2$O ice absorption. The IR-excess-bearing YSO candidates correlate spatially with dust filaments and molecular gas demonstrating their embedded state. The distribution of stellar and candidate YSO populations across N159 reveal more evolved star-forming populations in the N159E region and newer star formation in the N159W region, supporting the sequential star formation scenario for this region.

title: Disk truncation triggers relativistic jet launching of a highly accreting supermassive black hole
background_knowledge: 相对论性喷流是宇宙中最极端的能量释放现象之一，通常由超大质量黑洞的吸积活动驱动，通过能量反馈深刻影响着星系的演化。目前解释喷流产生的主流理论是Blandford-Znajek（BZ）机制，即通过吸积流所维持的大尺度磁场来提取黑洞的旋转能。然而，该机制的有效运转在观测上通常需要依赖高温且几何上较厚（geometrically-thick）的吸积流。对于具有高吸积率的黑洞系统，理论预期其吸积区应由低温且几何上较薄（geometrically-thin）的吸积盘主导，这种薄盘极难维持大尺度磁场。因此，高吸积率环境中为何仍能产生强烈的相对论性喷流，构成了吸积与喷流物理学中的一个长期未解之谜与悖论。
contribution: 本研究联合了XRISM的高分辨率X射线微量热计光谱观测，以及GMVA、VLBA和EAVN的毫米波/射电干涉阵列，对宽线射电星系3C120进行了协同观测。高分辨X射线光谱揭示了相对论性展宽的Fe-Kα谱线，首次明确指出该系统的高温几何薄盘在距离黑洞约20个引力半径处发生截断，其内部区域被高温的几何厚吸积流所取代。同时，高精度射电成像显示，将喷流轮廓外推至黑洞视界处的半径与该吸积盘截断半径相当甚至更窄。这一成果直接证明了即使在高吸积率条件下，喷流的发射也紧密依赖于内部的高温厚吸积流（可能驱动了BZ机制），为黑洞吸积盘几何结构转变触发喷流的普适性“盘-喷流联系”提供了决定性的观测证据。
summary: Relativistic jets are among the most energetic phenomena in the Universe and influence galaxy evolution through energetic feedback, yet the physical connection between accretion flows and jet launching remains unresolved. Jet production is widely attributed to the Blandford-Znajek mechanism, which extracts black hole rotational energy via large-scale magnetic fields sustained by an accretion flow. Although this mechanism is observationally well supported for hot, geometrically-thick accretion flows, highly accreting environments with strong jets present a paradox, as they are typically dominated by cold, geometrically-thin disks incapable of sustaining large-scale magnetic fields. Here, we report coordinated X-ray microcalorimeter spectroscopy achieved by X-ray Imaging and Spectroscopy Mission (XRISM) and millimeter/radio interferometric observations by Global Millimeter VLBI Array (GMVA), Very Long Baseline Array (VLBA), and East Asian VLBI Network (EAVN) on the broad-line radio galaxy 3C120. High-resolution X-ray spectroscopy reveals a relativistically-broadened Fe-K$α$ line, indicating that the cold, geometrically-thin disk is truncated at $\sim 20~R_{\rm g}$ ($R_{\rm g}$ is the gravitational radius), with the inner region replaced by a hot, geometrically-thick flow. Concurrently, radio imaging indicates that jet profile extrapolation toward the black hole horizon yields a radius comparable to or even narrower than the disk truncation radius. These results demonstrate that, even at high accretion rates, jet launching is linked to a hot inner flow, possibly via the Blandford-Znajek process, providing evidence for a universal disk-jet connection via geometric transition.

title: In-Situ Star Formation in a Thick Disk: A Model for Metal Enrichment of Mrk 573
background_knowledge: 活动星系核（AGN）由星系中心的超大质量黑洞及其周围的吸积盘组成。在一些近邻的塞弗特（Seyfert）星系中，观测经常揭示出其核区及外流（如双锥区）具有异常高的金属丰度。传统观点认为这些重元素来源于星系整体演化历史中的恒星形成过程。然而，现代吸积盘理论指出，当吸积盘的外部区域变得引力不稳定时，气体可能会发生碎裂，从而在盘内“原位”（in-situ）触发恒星形成。这些原位形成的大质量恒星通过快速演化和超新星爆发，能够向AGN周围环境释放大量重元素，这为理解AGN附近局部高度富金属现象提供了一个重要的物理图像。
contribution: 本文针对近邻塞弗特星系Mrk 573核区及喷流双锥区的高金属丰度观测结果，提出了一个基于吸积盘内原位恒星形成的金属增丰模型。研究假设在吸积盘内遵循Salpeter初始质量函数形成了10至30太阳质量的恒星族群，并计算了其金属产出。结果表明，在厚盘（标高比 H/r ~ 0.1）假设下，该恒星族群能很好地解释观测到的金属增丰现象；而薄盘（H/r ≲ 0.01）模型则与观测不符。该模型揭示了AGN的金属丰度与吸积盘厚度之间存在强相关性，为通过观测推断吸积盘几何结构提供了一个潜在的有力探针。
summary: Recent observations of the nearby Seyfert galaxy Mrk 573 found that the galactic nucleus and bicone regions surrounding the jet are significantly metal-enriched. In this paper, we develop a simple model for the observed metal enrichment, assuming a population of stars in the $10 - 30 \, M_{\odot}$ range formed in-situ in the accretion disk. We assume the stars form according to a Salpeter initial mass function and generate the typical metal yields expected of field stars of the same mass. We find that in the thick disk ($H/r \sim 0.1$) case, a Salpeter population of stars can easily explain the observed metal enrichment and provide limits on the formation model; we also argue that a thin disk ($H/r \lesssim 0.01$) is incompatible with the observed metal enrichment. In our model, AGN metallicity scales most strongly with disk thickness, implying a potentially powerful observable diagnostic.

title: From starlight to dark matter: a stochastic interpolation approach to map dark matter from stellar density
background_knowledge: 星系的暗物质晕轮廓蕴含着关于暗物质物理本质及星系形成演化历史的关键信息。在传统研究范式中，精确限制银河系外星系的暗物质空间分布通常依赖于高观测成本的光谱学巡天，以获取恒星或气体的运动学（动力学）信息。相比之下，通过大规模测光巡天获取星系中发光重子物质（如恒星）的密度分布更为高效且数据量庞大。探索如何从容易观测的发光星光中可靠地反演不可见的暗物质分布，是当前暗物质探测和星系动力学研究的重要前沿。近年来，依托高精度的宇宙学流体动力学模拟，生成式人工智能模型为构建重子物质与暗物质空间分布之间的统计映射关系提供了全新的工具。
contribution: 本文提出了一种条件生成模型（随机插值）框架，旨在直接从恒星密度轮廓推演类银河系质量星系的二维暗物质密度图谱。利用DREAMS流体动力学模拟进行模型训练，结果表明该模型恢复暗物质密度的典型精度约为0.1 dex，并能通过随机采样提供一致的预测不确定度估计。研究还利用IllustrisTNG和FIRE模拟进行了域外泛化测试，发现该模型能够定性推广至TNG50星系，但对底层星系形成物理模型较为敏感（如在FIRE星系内部中心区域存在约0.2-0.4 dex的高估）。此工作证明了生成模型作为一种灵活且具有不确定度感知框架的潜力，为未来将大型测光巡天数据转化为高空间分辨的暗物质图谱奠定了基础。
summary: The dark matter halo profile in galaxies holds key information about the nature of dark matter and galaxy formation. Constraining the dark matter profile of galaxies beyond the Milky Way traditionally requires expensive spectroscopic observations for kinematic information. In this paper, we explore a conditional generative model framework to map the dark matter profile of Milky Way-mass galaxies from stellar density profiles, more easily obtainable through large photometric imaging surveys. As a proof of concept, we train the model to learn a stochastic bridge between instrument systematics-free baryonic stellar distributions and underlying dark matter density maps from the DREAMS hydrodynamics simulation suite. We recover 2D dark matter density profiles with a typical accuracy of $\sim0.1$ dex ($\sim1.5$% of the truth in log scale). The stochastic sampling procedure provides uncertainty estimates of the predicted dark matter map, with typical values $\sim0.1$ dex. Out-of-domain tests with Milky Way-mass galaxies from IllustrisTNG and FIRE simulations show that, while the model can qualitatively be generalized to TNG50 galaxies from IllustrisTNG, the model is sensitive to the galaxy formation model, with $\sim0.2$-$0.4$ dex over-prediction for the inner profiles ($r\lesssim5$ kpc) of the FIRE test galaxies. Future work will explore training with additional suites of simulations and/or conditioning on additional information, such as multi-band images. Our results are a first step towards using generative models as a flexible, uncertainty-aware framework for turning forthcoming data from large imaging surveys into spatially resolved dark matter maps.

title: On the rates of binary star collisions around hypermassive black holes
background_knowledge: 在绝大多数星系中心，都潜伏着质量从十万到上百亿倍太阳质量的超大质量黑洞（SMBH），其中质量超过一亿倍太阳质量的被称为极大质量黑洞（HMBH）。当恒星由于轨道摄动过于靠近黑洞时，黑洞的强大潮汐力会将其撕裂，产生潮汐撕裂事件（TDE），释放出剧烈的多波段电磁耀发。然而，由于黑洞的事件视界半径随质量线性增长，而恒星的潮汐撕裂半径随黑洞质量的三分之一次方增长，对于质量超过约一亿倍太阳质量的HMBH，其视界范围会完全包裹住主序星的潮汐半径。这意味着单颗主序星在被撕裂前就会被黑洞直接吞噬，无法产生传统的TDE暂现源。另一方面，星系中心不仅存在单星，还存在双星系统。当双星系统通过损失锥动力学被散射至黑洞附近时，黑洞的潮汐力会剧烈扰动双星内部的轨道动力学，导致双星轨道偏心率激增，进而引发双星内部的碰撞与并合。这种由黑洞引力诱发的双星碰撞可以产生强烈的电磁辐射，为探测无法产生传统TDE的极大质量黑洞提供了全新的观测探针和研究途径。
contribution: 本文利用蒙特卡洛模拟和基于后牛顿近似的多体动力学代码（Multistar），系统研究了双星系统与质量在10^5至10^10倍太阳质量之间的星系中心黑洞交会时的演化统计特征。研究发现，在所有测试的双星参数分布模型中均会发生恒星碰撞（碰撞概率在0.2%至7%之间），且主要发生在顺行轨道、低撞击参数的紧凑双星系统中，其物理机制是黑洞潮汐力在双星经过近黑洞点时显著推高了双星偏心率。研究指出，对于较高质量的黑洞（>10^8倍太阳质量），恒星碰撞速度分布更广，意味着恒星并合的比例大幅增加。结合经验损失锥事件率与局部黑洞质量函数，作者预测了未来LSST（薇拉·鲁宾天文台）巡天的可探测事件率：在10^6、10^8和10^9倍太阳质量黑洞周围，每年分别可探测到数千次、数百次和数次碰撞事件。这一结果表明，极大质量黑洞周围的双星碰撞代表了一类重要且潜在可观测的核区暂现源族群，可能对解释当前宽视场光学巡天中发现的日益增多的不明核区暂现源样本作出重要贡献。
summary: Observations of the Milky Way show that galaxies have binary stars in their centres. Using Monte Carlo simulations, we model the population statistics of encounters of such binaries with galactic central black holes (BHs) of mass 10^5-10^{10} Msun (hypermassive BHs >= 10^8 Msun HMBHs). Whereas main-sequence single stars cannot undergo tidal disruption events around HMBHs, stellar collisions of main-sequence binary stars may produce observable transients. We use the post-Newtonian Einstein-Infeld-Hoffmann (EIH) equations as implemented in the three-body code Multistar. We simulate 100,000 models each for six BH masses and 10 different binary parameter distributions. We find that stellar collisions occur in all models, with collision fractions ranging from ~7% for circular, equal-mass binaries to ~0.2% for the observationally motivated Moe2017 binary distribution. Most collisions occur for prograde, tight binaries at low impact parameters beta = r_t/r_p, where the tidal force of the BH drives up the binary eccentricity during pericentre passage. Collision velocities are close to the binary escape velocity for lower-mass BHs (<= 10^8 Msun), but span a wider range for higher-mass BHs, implying an increasing fraction of stellar mergers. Using empirical loss-cone rates and the local BH mass function, we estimate detectable LSST collision rates of ~8,600 and ~3,000 events per year for our Kroupa mass function, Opik's law, inclined orbit model and our MS17 model, respectively, around 10^6 Msun BHs; ~330 and ~150 events per year around 10^8 Msun BHs; and ~3.5 and ~2.8 events per year around 10^9 Msun BHs. These results suggest that binary stellar collisions around HMBHs represent a potentially observable population of nuclear transients that may contribute to the growing sample of ambiguous nuclear transients detected by wide-field optical surveys.

title: Juice-SWI during the Lunar-Earth-Gravity-Assist (LEGA) - Part 2: Instrument operations
background_knowledge: 木星冰月探测器（JUICE）是由欧洲空间局（ESA）主导的大型深空探测任务，旨在研究木星系统及其巨大的冰卫星。由于前往外太阳系的航程漫长且需要巨大的速度增量，深空探测器通常会采用引力辅助（Gravity Assist）技术，即借助行星或卫星的引力来改变自身的速度和轨道（例如地月引力辅助，LEGA）。探测器上搭载的亚毫米波仪器（SWI）是一种高分辨率光谱仪，能够探测木星中层大气、冰月外逸层的化学成分以及地表热物理性质。由于任务轨道极为复杂且观测目标多样，仪器在抵达木星系统前，必须在巡航阶段（Cruise Phase）利用地球、月球等已知天体进行充分的在轨标定与操作策略验证，以确保未来科学观测的可靠性。
contribution: 本文详细介绍了木星冰月探测器（JUICE）搭载的亚毫米波仪器（SWI）在地月引力辅助（LEGA）期间的仪器操作概念及面临的规划与指令挑战。研究团队针对探测器巡航阶段制定了全面的标定策略，不仅利用此次LEGA机会有效提升了仪器的在轨标定精度，还成功验证了未来飞掠木星冰月时所需的复杂操作与观测策略。
summary: The Jupiter Icy Moons Explorer (Juice) embarked in 2023 on a 8-year interplanetary journey to Jupiter and its icy moons. The Submillimetre Wave Instrument (SWI) is one of the ten science instruments aboard the spacecraft. SWI is a sophisticated and first-of-its-kind payload visiting the outer solar system, featuring dual-band tunable receivers, two independent pointing mechanisms, and spectrometers capable of high resolution (up to a resolving power of 10^{7}). It is designed to support the diverse science objectives of the Juice mission targeting Jupiter's middle atmosphere, icy-moon's exospheres as well as near sub-surface thermophysical properties. For this purpose the Juice mission adopts a complex trajectory tour within the Jovian system, which further necessitates a sophisticated, mission-driven operations concept for SWI. This presents significant planning, operations and commanding challenges which are described in this paper in the context of the Lunar and Earth Gravity Assist (LEGA). After the development and ground calibration of the instrument, the SWI Team has designed a comprehensive calibration strategy applicable during the Cruise Phase of Juice. Among the various opportunities for calibration, including the Near-Earth Commissioning Phase and more than ten Payload Checkout Windows, the LEGA offers the means not only to improve the calibration of the instrument, but also to validate the operational strategy of future icy moon flybys.

title: Energy estimation of direct and reflected cosmic-ray events aboard balloon-borne radio detectors
background_knowledge: 超高能宇宙线（UHECRs）和高能中微子进入地球大气层时，会与大气分子发生剧烈相互作用，引发级联反应并产生广延大气簇射（Extensive Air Showers, EAS）。这些次级带电粒子在地球磁场中偏转或通过阿斯卡莱恩效应（Askaryan effect）会产生射电频段的电磁辐射。利用高空气球搭载射电探测器是一种极为高效的探测手段，因为它们可以居高临下地俯视并监测覆盖极大体积的地球大气和冰层。然而，由于气球探测器只能从单一的高海拔视角接收射电信号，无法像传统的地面探测器阵列那样对同一事件进行多点空间采样，因此利用传统方法直接重建空气簇射的原始能量一直面临极大的技术挑战。
contribution: 本文提出了一套基于模拟的全面能量重建框架，专为气球载荷观测到的独特宇宙线事件几何特征而设计。研究首次将该方法调整并应用于直接掠过大气的宇宙线簇射，并充分考虑了其在稀薄空气中高度不对称的发展过程。此外，研究通过将球面反射和射电波散焦机制直接纳入模拟，大幅更新了针对向下传播且经地表反射簇射的能量重建方法。作者在多种事件几何构型下严格验证了该方法，实现了约8-11%的基线能量分辨率，并系统性量化了探测器有限指向分辨率、未知原初粒子质量成分以及信噪比带来的系统误差，为PUEO和POEMMA-Balloon等下一代气球探测任务建立了一个稳健的宇宙线分析框架。
summary: Balloon-borne radio detectors offer a highly effective approach to monitoring immense volumes of the Earth's atmosphere and ice for ultra-high-energy cosmic rays and neutrinos. Because these payloads measure radio emission from a single, highly elevated vantage point, reconstructing the air-shower energy using traditional methods is not possible. In this work, we present a comprehensive, simulation-based energy reconstruction framework tailored to the unique cosmic-ray event geometries observed by balloon payloads. For the first time, we adapt and apply this methodology to direct atmosphere-skimming cosmic-ray showers, accounting for their highly asymmetric development in rarefied air. Furthermore, we provide a major update to the energy reconstruction of reflected downward-going showers by incorporating spherical reflection and ray de-focusing mechanics directly into simulations. We rigorously validate the method across different event geometries, demonstrating a baseline energy resolution of $8-11\%$. Finally, we quantify the systematic effects of finite detector pointing resolution, unknown primary mass composition, and signal-to-noise ratio, establishing a robust framework for the analysis of cosmic-ray events in next-generation balloon missions such as PUEO and POEMMA-Balloon with Radio.

title: Multi-Band Optical Variability Characteristics of the $γ$-ray emitting blazar 1ES 0647+250 during its 2020 flare
background_knowledge: 耀变体（Blazar）是活动星系核（AGN）中极为活跃的一类，其显著特征是拥有一条几乎直指地球的相对论性喷流。耀变体的电磁辐射覆盖从射电到伽马射线的全波段，且主要由非热辐射主导。其低能段辐射（通常从射电、光学延伸至X射线波段）主要源于喷流中相对论性电子的同步辐射。耀变体在全波段均表现出剧烈且快速的光变特性（Variability），经常发生爆发事件。通过多波段光学监测其光变行为（如光变幅度、波段间的时间延迟以及颜色-星等相关性，如经典的“变亮时变蓝”现象），天文学家能够深入探究喷流内部的粒子加速、冷却机制以及磁场结构。
contribution: 本研究利用Vainu Bappu天文台（B、V、R波段）和ZTF巡天（zg、zr波段）的测光数据，对发射伽马射线的高同步辐射峰耀变体1ES 0647+250在2020年爆发期间的多波段光学光变特征进行了分析。研究发现该源在各光学波段表现出一致的光变，R波段峰值星等达到15.74等，且B波段的本征光变幅度最大；颜色-星等图揭示了统计上显著的“变亮时变蓝”（Bluer-When-Brighter）趋势；离散相关函数分析显示V和R波段间的时间延迟接近于零，表明辐射是同时发生的。观测到的光谱变硬现象符合同步辐射主导的光学辐射特征，这极可能与该源活跃期间喷流内部粒子加速过程的增强有关。
summary: We present a multi-band optical variability study of the $γ$-ray emitting high-synchrotron-peaked blazar 1ES~0647+250 during its enhanced optical activity in 2020. The analysis utilizes 107 epochs of high-precision $B$, $V$, and $R$-band photometry obtained with the 75 cm telescope at the Vainu Bappu Observatory, combined with high-cadence $z_g$ and $z_r$ survey data from the Zwicky Transient Facility. The combined light curves reveal coherent variability across all optical filters, with the source reaching a peak $R$-band magnitude of 15.74 mag. We calculated the variability amplitude, finding the highest intrinsic variability in the B- band. Spectral analysis using color--magnitude diagrams reveals a statistically significant ``Bluer-When-Brighter'' trend, supported by a Pearson correlation coefficient of $r = 0.68$ ($p < 0.001$) for the (V$-$R) index. Furthermore, the discrete correlation function analysis indicates a near-zero time lag between the $V$ and $R$ bands, suggesting simultaneous emission within the observational cadence. The observed spectral hardening is consistent with synchrotron-dominated optical emission, likely associated with enhanced particle acceleration within the jet during the active phase of 1ES~0647+250.

title: Shape Degeneracies: the likely culprit for the differences between lens mass models of galaxy clusters
background_knowledge: 星系团的引力透镜效应被广泛用于约束暗物质的物理性质，并作为天然的“宇宙望远镜”放大高红移背景星系，使得探测极端暗弱星系的光度函数成为可能。获取高精度和高准确度的星系团投影质量分布图（Mass maps）是此类研究的核心前提。然而，透镜质量模型的重建属于典型的反问题，不可避免地受到“透镜简并”（Lensing degeneracies）的限制，即不同的透镜质量分布能够产生相同的观测图像（如多重像的位置）。尽管天文学界已经熟知质量片简并（Mass Sheet Degeneracy）和源位置变换（Source Position Transformation）等经典简并类型，但在实际操作中，不同算法重建的同一星系团质量图在小尺度（<30 kpc）等密度轮廓上往往存在无法用上述经典简并解释的显著系统性差异。
contribution: 本文通过解析方法系统研究了引力透镜中的“形状简并”（Shape degeneracies），确认其是导致不同模型在小尺度上产生质量图差异的主要原因。研究得出了三个核心结论：（1）形状简并极大可能是造成不同技术所恢复的星系团透镜质量图存在差异的根本原因；（2）在透镜平面上多重像系统空间分布密集的区域，形状简并效应会被显著抑制；（3）对于拥有大量多重像的星系团（如 MACS J0416），形状简并对同一源的多重像时间延迟的系统性影响总体较小（约 1%），但在部分背景源中其影响可达约 10%，这会对利用透镜时间延迟精确测定哈勃常数（H_0）产生重要影响。
summary: Sky-projected mass distributions of galaxy clusters are widely used to constrain particle properties of dark matter, to magnify in flux and angular extent high redshift background galaxies, and to construct their luminosity function down to faint absolute magnitudes that are otherwise hard or impossible to reach. Obtaining accurate and precise mass maps of clusters is therefore of central importance for these studies. Yet, a visual inspection of any two mass maps of the same cluster shows that the shapes of their isodensity contours are often dissimilar in detail on <30kpc scales, and there is no simple relation connecting the two. These differences are due to systematic uncertainties in reconstructions, which are in turn due to lensing degeneracies. However, commonly known degeneracies, like the mass sheet degeneracy or the source position transformation cannot account for most of these differences, implying that more generalized shape degeneracies are responsible. In this paper we study shape degeneracies using an analytical approach. We conclude with three main takeaways: (i) Shape degeneracies are the likely cause of differences in the mass maps of cluster lenses recovered by different techniques. (ii) Shape degeneracies are significantly suppressed in regions of the lens plane that have tight groupings of lensed images. (iii) In clusters where image numbers are high, such as MACS J0416, their effect on time delays between images from the same source are generally small, of order 1%, but can reach ~10% for some multiply imaged background sources, affecting the determination of H_0.

title: Search for High-Ionization Nebular Emission (SHINE). I. A Systematically Selected [Ne V] Sample at z > 3 with JWST/NIRSpec PRISM
background_knowledge: 高电离态星云发射线（如[Ne V]，其产生需要约97 eV的高电离能）通常需要极硬的辐射场才能激发。在星系尺度上，这种高能光子主要由活动星系核（AGN）中吸积的超大质量黑洞产生，而普通的恒星形成活动很难提供足够的能量。传统上，搜寻高红移（z > 3）的AGN主要依赖于X射线探测、宽发射线特征或特定的静止系光学发射线比值（如BPT图）。然而，由于尘埃遮蔽、探测灵敏度限制或早期宇宙星系星际介质性质的演化，传统方法可能会漏掉许多处于早期生长阶段的黑洞。随着詹姆斯·韦伯空间望远镜（JWST）的升空，其强大的近红外光谱能力使得天文学家能够直接探测早期宇宙中的[Ne V]等高电离发射线，从而为寻找和研究早期超大质量黑洞的形成与演化提供了一种全新的互补探针。
contribution: 本文利用JWST/NIRSpec PRISM光谱数据开展了首次高电离星云发射系统性搜寻（SHINE项目）。在超过9000个z > 3的星系样本中，研究团队成功证认了25个[Ne V]发射源（红移跨度3.059至9.444）。研究发现这些发射源的宿主星系在形态、连续谱特征和恒星质量上极其多样化，且大多数并不符合传统的高红移AGN诊断标准（如窄线比或宽线分类）。部分源具有X射线对应体，表明高光度[Ne V]发射源并不总是缺乏X射线辐射。强[Ne V]辐射和硬谱线比值表明黑洞吸积是这些系统主要的能量来源，从而确立了[Ne V]发射线作为探测早期宇宙黑洞生长的重要互补工具。
summary: We conduct the first systematic Search for High-Ionization Nebular Emission (SHINE) using [Ne V]$\lambda3426$ in JWST/NIRSpec PRISM spectroscopy at $z>3$. From more than 9,000 galaxies, we identify 25 [Ne V] emitters spanning $z=3.059$-$9.444$ and $\log_{10}(L_{\rm [Ne\,V]}/erg\,s^{-1})=40.70$-$42.86$. Their [Ne V] luminosities overlap with those of local [Ne V]-selected active galactic nuclei (AGNs) and exceed those of local metal-poor [Ne V] emitters, although such low-luminosity systems would fall below our sensitivity. The population is diverse, spanning compact and extended morphologies and a broad range of continuum properties and stellar masses, including very low-mass hosts. It includes sources with broad Balmer emission as well as others whose higher-resolution spectra do not require a broad component. The [Ne V] emitters overlap only partly with conventional AGN diagnostics: most do not satisfy conservative high-redshift AGN criteria based on strong rest-optical narrow-line ratios, and only a minority have adopted broad-line classifications. [Ne V] upper limits for independently selected broad-line AGNs and little red dots are too shallow to establish a population-wide [Ne V] deficit. Six sources have secure Chandra counterparts, showing that X-ray weakness is not universal among luminous [Ne V] emitters. Strong [Ne V]/[Ne III] emission is associated with redder ultraviolet slopes and stronger Balmer breaks, but not with UV luminosity, possibly linking strong high-ionization emission to recent changes in star formation. The observed incidence of luminous [Ne V] emission shows no significant evolution over $z>3$, despite an increasing robust [Ne III] detection fraction. The high [Ne V] luminosities and hard line ratios favor black-hole accretion as the dominant power source, establishing [Ne V] emission as a complementary probe of early black-hole growth.

title: A High Resolution View of Three Massive Young Stellar Objects in the Magellanic Clouds
background_knowledge: 大质量恒星主导着星系的化学增丰与能量反馈，但其形成机制（如单核吸积或竞争吸积）仍是天体物理学的研究难点，主要因其演化迅速且深埋于致密高消光的分子云中。麦哲伦星云（包含大麦哲伦星云LMC和小麦哲伦星云SMC）具有较低的金属丰度与独特的星际环境，是研究非典型银河系环境下恒星形成的理想天然实验室。借助阿塔卡马大型毫米波/亚毫米波阵列（ALMA）的高分辨率射电干涉观测，天文学家能够在天文单位（au）尺度上直接解析大质量年轻恒星体（MYSO）的尘埃连续谱、分子外流及致密气体的运动学特征，从而探究大质量恒星形成过程在不同星系环境中的普适性与特殊性。
contribution: 利用ALMA Band 7长基线观测，以迄今最高的分辨率（约0.03角秒，即1500 au）解析了麦哲伦星云中三个大质量年轻恒星体（LMC中的Lh03、Lh09及SMC中的S07）。研究发现：0.87 mm连续谱揭示了不同程度的物理碎裂现象（从S07的单一紧凑源到Lh09中包含17个候选核心的星团）；所有目标均被探测到高速CO(3-2)分子外流，并在Lh09中确认了高度准直的双极喷流；HCO+和SO等谱线揭示的速度梯度指示了旋转环面或复杂的动力学特征。这些现象在定性上与银河系内的MYSO高度相似，表明大质量恒星的基本形成过程在跨环境条件下具有普适性，但观测到的高度个体差异也为未来开展更大规模的高分辨率巡天提供了重要动机。
summary: The Magellanic Clouds provide an excellent laboratory to study massive star formation beyond typical Galactic environments. Using ALMA band 7 long-baseline observations, we present the highest resolution (approximately 0.03", $1500{\rm\:au}$) view to date of three massive young stellar objects (MYSOs) in the Magellanic Clouds, i.e., Lh03 and Lh09 in the LMC, and S07 in the SMC. The 0.87 mm continuum, with a sensitivity of $\sim30\:μ$Jy beam$^{-1}$, reveals varying levels of fragmentation, from a single compact source (S07), a few (Lh03), to a cluster of compact sources (Lh09). In Lh09, we identified 17 core candidates with lowest measured mass of 2.6 Msun, and their de-projected separations peak around 6000~au. All three targets exhibit high velocity CO(3--2) outflows, including detection of a collimated bipolar jet driven by a core in Lh09. Spectral lines from HCO$^+$, SO, and SO$_2$ are detected in all sources. We observe velocity gradients that likely trace rotating toroids (Lh03) or more complex motions (Lh09, S07). Taken together, these phenomena observed on $\sim1500$~au scales are qualitatively similar to those seen in Galactic MYSOs, suggesting a degree of universality in the basic processes of massive star formation across different environments. Nevertheless, the substantial source-to-source diversity in continuum morphology and dense-gas kinematics motivates larger high-resolution surveys to determine how these properties vary with source characteristics and environment.

title: A Simple Miniaturized Stellar Interferometer: Measuring the Angular Diameter of Venus with a Masked Telescope
background_knowledge: 天文干涉测量技术是天文学中用于突破单镜片衍射极限、获取天体极高空间分辨率图像的核心技术。其基本原理基于光的干涉现象：当把相距一定基线距离的两个或多个孔径接收到的星光进行相干叠加时，会产生明暗相间的干涉条纹。根据范西特-泽尼克定理（Van Cittert-Zernike theorem），干涉条纹的可见度（对比度）与光源的角大小及其空间亮度分布密切相关。对于具有一定角直径的延展光源（如行星表面或恒星圆面），随着干涉基线的增加，光源不同部分产生的干涉条纹会相互错位叠加，导致整体干涉条纹的对比度下降直至完全消失。通过测量干涉条纹消失（即出现零可见度）时的临界基线长度，可以直接反推出天体的角直径。这一原理在1921年由迈克耳孙和皮斯首次应用于天文观测，成功测量了参宿四的角直径，奠定了现代光学天文干涉阵列（如VLT、CHARA）的基础。
contribution: 本文设计并展示了一套简单且直观的微型恒星干涉仪教学实验装置，利用标准行星望远镜和带有两个小孔的不透明塑料掩膜实现了天文干涉测量。研究表明，通过改变小孔间距（基线长度）并观察干涉条纹的消失，可以直接估算金星的角直径（利用15毫米的基线即可测量10-15角秒的金星）。该实验方案在常规的大气视宁度条件下即可稳定运行，无需复杂的现代光学调试技巧，并通过金星或木星（延展光源）与天狼星（点光源）的并排观测对比，为学生提供了一个低门槛、多难度层级的经典干涉物理图像还原（致敬1921年迈克耳孙-皮斯实验）。
summary: We describe a simple, visually compelling demonstration/laboratory of astronomical interferometry using a standard planetary telescope and a thin piece of opaque plastic punched with two small holes. By observing the disappearance of interference fringes as the hole spacing is increased, students can directly estimate the angular diameter of Venus. The demonstration is a tabletop analogue of the landmark 1921 Michelson-Pease measurement of Betelgeuse and scales naturally from that measurement: where Michelson and Pease required a 6.1 m baseline to resolve a disk 47 mas (milli-arcsecond) across, a 15 mm baseline suffices for Venus, when it is approximately 10-15$''$ (arc seconds). The lab works reliably in ordinary atmospheric seeing conditions, and a side-by-side comparison of Venus (or Jupiter) with a bright star such as Sirius provides an immediate visual demonstration of the difference between extended and point sources. It works equally well as a laboratory at a variety of difficulty levels. Furthermore, it does not require advanced knowledge or skills with optical telescopes. While the underlying ideas are well known, we are unaware of any source that presents them in an accessible, unified form.

title: A Multiband Catalog of Infrared-Excess Sources in the Vela-Carina Region: VVVX, DECaPS, and GLIMPSE
background_knowledge: 在恒星形成过程中，年轻恒星体（YSO）通常被包含尘埃和气体的星周盘或包层所包围。这些星周物质会吸收中心恒星的短波辐射（如紫外线和可见光），并在长波段（特别是红外波段）重新辐射，形成明显的‘红外超’（Infrared Excess）现象。因此，寻找红外超是证认年轻恒星体、研究星周物质和恒星形成演化过程的经典且重要的方法。然而，在银道面（Galactic midplane）区域进行探测时，极高的星际尘埃消光和严重的恒星拥挤（crowding）现象给源的识别带来了巨大挑战。为了克服这些困难并准确区分真正的星周物质辐射与背景噪声，天文学家通常需要结合可见光、近红外和中红外等多波段巡天数据，构建完整的光谱能量分布（SED）来进行精确诊断。
contribution: 本文在船帆-船底座（Vela-Carina）区域约7.0平方度的天区内，构建了一个高质量的红外超候选体多波段星表。研究团队交叉匹配了DECaPS（可见光）、VVVX（近红外）和Spitzer/GLIMPSE（中红外）的测光数据，利用中红外颜色诊断进行初步筛选，并结合Gaia距离和NEOWISE时域数据，通过VOSA工具进行详细的光谱能量分布（SED）分析。最终从近25万个匹配源中成功证认出1,512个中红外超天体，其中191个拥有高信噪比的完整12波段测光。研究发现，该星表与既有的YSO或变源星表重合度较低，证明了中红外超筛选方法能有效补充现有的YSO证认手段，为未来的光谱学和时域天文学研究提供了包含同源多波段测光、SED特征、距离和光变诊断的可靠基础样本。
summary: Multiwavelength surveys of the Galactic midplane enable the identification of infrared-excess sources, signatures of circumstellar material, though high extinction and crowding hinder detection. We construct a homogeneous catalog of infrared-excess candidates in a $\sim$7.0 deg$^2$ field of the Vela-Carina region, characterizing their excess emission via spectral energy distribution (SED) analysis. We combine optical photometry from DECaPS, near-infrared photometry from VVVX, and mid-infrared photometry from Spitzer/GLIMPSE using hierarchical positional cross-matching. Candidates are selected via photometric quality and MIR color diagnostics, and their SEDs are analyzed with VOSA using theoretical atmosphere model grids. Photogeometric distances are adopted, while Gaia DR3 and NEOWISE variability provide complementary diagnostics. From the matched 249,719-source VVVX-GLIMPSE-DECaPS catalog, we identify 1,512 MIR-excess objects, of which 191 have complete 12-band photometry with S/N > 10, enabling detailed SED analysis. Photogeometric distances are statistically consistent with geometric distances for nearly the entire sample. SED analysis independently supports the MIR-excess nature of most sources, indicating emission beyond stellar photospheres. About 15% of sources are flagged variable by Gaia, while NEOWISE light curves reveal MIR variability of a few tenths of a magnitude. Comparisons with published YSO and variability-selected catalogs show limited overlap, particularly with variability-selected samples, indicating that MIR-excess selection complements other approaches to identifying candidate YSOs in the Vela-Carina region. The resulting catalog provides a well-defined MIR-excess sample with homogeneous multiband photometry, SED characterization, distances, and variability diagnostics, forming a foundation for future spectroscopic and time-domain studies.

title: Estimating redshift distributions of Fermi blazars with multiple machine-learning models
background_knowledge: 耀变体（Blazar）是一类特殊的活动星系核（AGN），其相对论性喷流几乎直指地球，是宇宙中最明亮的伽马射线源之一。费米伽马射线空间望远镜（Fermi-LAT）在巡天过程中探测到了大量耀变体，但红移（代表天体距离与所处宇宙时代）的缺失成为了制约该领域发展的一大瓶颈。由于获取高质量光谱以精确测量红移需要耗费大量望远镜时间，且对暗弱天体极其困难，目前约一半的Fermi耀变体缺乏光谱红移数据。这严重限制了天文学家对伽马射线耀变体光度函数、群体统计特征以及宇宙学演化规律的研究。近年来，基于多波段观测数据利用机器学习算法预测天体红移，并结合概率密度分布来量化预测的不确定性，已成为弥补这一观测数据缺失问题的重要研究范式。
contribution: 本文开发了一个包含35个机器学习回归模型的多模型集成统计框架，用于系统评估和估计缺乏光谱观测的Fermi耀变体红移。研究通过整合不同模型的预测结果，为每个天体构建了包含量化不确定性的非参数红移概率密度函数（PDF）。主要成果包括：(1) 编制并发布了包含1590个无红移耀变体的预测红移分布星表；(2) 通过堆叠单源PDF，在不依赖源类别标签的情况下，成功恢复了耀变体群体的特征双峰红移结构；(3) 发现类型不确定的耀变体候选者红移分布亦呈双峰结构，暗示类似平谱射电类星体（FSRQ）的贡献略大。该工作为耀变体的群体与演化研究提供了强有力的数据支持，同时凸显了不确定性感知的多模型集成方法在天文数据分析中的广泛实用价值。
summary: Approximately half of the Fermi-LAT-detected blazars lack spectroscopic redshift measurements, which limits population studies and investigations of the cosmological evolution of the gamma-ray blazar population. We aim to develop a multi-model ensemble framework to systematically evaluate the performance of machine-learning models for blazar redshift estimation and to provide predictive redshift probability distributions with quantified uncertainties for all blazars without measured redshifts. We construct an ensemble of 35 machine-learning regression models in the $1/(1+z)$ space. Predictions from individual models are combined to build non-parametric redshift probability density functions (PDFs) for each source, allowing an explicit characterization of predictive uncertainty. The source-level PDFs are subsequently stacked to derive population-level redshift distributions. Across the diverse models within our framework, we find comparable predictive performance, indicating a feature-limited performance plateau. We compile a catalog of predictive redshift distributions for 1,590 blazars without measured redshifts. The stacked PDFs recover the characteristic double-peaked redshift structure of blazars without using source class labels. For blazar candidates of uncertain type, the predicted redshift distribution exhibits a bimodal structure, suggesting a slightly larger contribution from FSRQ-like sources. Our multi-model statistical framework achieves competitive predictive performance while retaining faint sources. We provide predicted redshift distributions with quantified uncertainties for 1,590 blazars without measured redshifts, offering improved support for population and evolutionary studies. More broadly, this approach highlights the practical value of uncertainty-aware multi-model regression ensembling in astronomical data analysis.

title: Compact Object Mergers and Micro-Tidal Disruption Events: A Multi-Messenger Probe of Dense Stellar Environments
background_knowledge: 在致密恒星环境（如球状星团或年轻大质量星团）中，恒星及致密天体（黑洞、中子星）的数密度极高，频繁发生复杂的动力学相互作用。这种环境是产生双致密天体并合以及潮汐瓦解事件（TDE）的天然“温床”。双致密天体并合是引力波探测（如LIGO/Virgo/KAGRA）的核心目标，而潮汐瓦解事件（恒星因过于靠近致密天体被引力撕裂并产生吸积发光）则能在电磁波段被观测到。微潮汐瓦解事件（μTDE，即恒星被恒星级黑洞或中子星瓦解）连接了这两种极端物理过程。结合引力波与电磁辐射观测的“多信使天文学”范式，能够帮助学者以前所未有的维度探究致密星团的动力学演化、致密天体的吸积与自旋增长机制，以及黑洞和中子星的质量分布规律。
contribution: 本文利用Rapster代码进行快速蒙特卡洛星团模拟，系统研究了致密恒星环境中的致密天体并合与（微）潮汐瓦解事件（μTDE）。研究改进了吸积盘作用下中子星向黑洞转变的自旋演化模型，并加入了单致密天体与双黑洞导致瓦解的新动力学通道。通过对10万个星团的模拟发现：双黑洞并合率密度在红移z≈2-3处达峰值且与本地LVK观测率一致，而μTDE的累积数量是并合事件的数倍（约90%源于单致密天体遭遇战，该事件率为保守下限）。此外，研究揭示μTDE期间的顺行吸积能有效增加致密天体自旋，不仅为产生随机取向的高自旋黑洞提供了纯动力学途径，还能驱动中子星经吸积诱导坍缩成为填补“低质量间隙”的小质量黑洞。
summary: Dense stellar environments such as globular clusters and young massive clusters produce both compact-object mergers detectable in gravitational waves and tidal disruption events observable electromagnetically. We investigate compact-object mergers, tidal disruption events, and micro-tidal disruption events ($μ$TDEs) in these environments using rapid Monte Carlo star-cluster simulations with the Rapster code, extended with a unified treatment of neutron-star (NS) and black-hole (BH) spin evolution under disk accretion across the NS-to-BH transition, as well as new dynamical channels for disruptions by single compact objects and by BH-BH binaries. Simulating $10^5$ clusters across ten model variations and two formation histories, we find a BH-BH merger-rate density peaking at $z\approx2$-$3$ at several tens ${\rm Gpc}^{-3}\,{\rm yr}^{-1}$, consistent with the local LVK rate, while the cumulative number of $μ$TDEs exceeds that of mergers by a factor of a few. Since we include only dynamically formed binaries, $\approx90\%$ of $μ$TDEs proceed through single compact-object-star encounters, and our rates are conservative lower limits. Prograde accretion during $μ$TDEs spins up compact objects, providing a purely dynamical, randomly oriented pathway for producing high-spin BHs, and can drive accretion-induced collapse of NSs to BHs that populate the lower mass gap.

title: Ubiquitous nuclear disks and bars embedded in massive galaxies in the cosmic morning
background_knowledge: 在星系形成与演化领域，星系形态的演化历史一直是个核心问题。传统星系形成理论通常认为，大质量星系的中心区域会首先通过并合或剧烈的不稳定性形成由恒星无规运动（弥散）主导的核球（bulge，即中心球状结构），随后外部才逐渐吸积气体并形成由旋转主导的延展星系盘。然而，随着对高红移宇宙（如红移 z~3 的“宇宙清晨”时期）观测能力的提升以及高分辨率宇宙学流体力学模拟（如IllustrisTNG项目中的TNG50）的发展，天文学家得以更精细地探究早期星系的内部物理结构。星系中心的早期形态究竟是核球还是类似盘状/棒状的旋转主导结构，直接关系到我们对星系质量组装途径和恒星形成历史的根本理解。
contribution: 本文利用TNG50宇宙学模拟，对红移z=3处的45个大质量星系的内部结构进行了详细研究。通过双Sérsic轮廓分解、等密度椭圆拟合、固有三维形状及恒星运动学测量，研究发现这些早期大质量星系的中心区域普遍是扁平且受旋转支撑的核盘（nuclear disks）和星系棒（bars），其Sérsic指数较低（n ≲ 1），而不是传统认为的核球。进一步的演化追踪表明，这些核盘和棒结构在富气体的致密化阶段就已形成，并且直到红移 z ≲ 1 时才转化为由弥散运动主导的椭球系统，而在此之前延展的恒星盘已经发育完全。这一结果表明，大质量星系盘完全可以围绕受旋转支撑的中心进行组装，缺乏核球的大质量星系可能是星系演化过程中的普遍产物。
summary: The morphology of the central regions of high-redshift galaxies remains relatively unexplored, while recent case studies suggest that giant disks can emerge without first developing a prominent central spheroid. Here, we investigate the inner structures of a mass-complete sample of 45 massive galaxies at $z=3$ in the TNG50 simulation. Through double-Sérsic profile decomposition, isodensity ellipse fitting, intrinsic three-dimensional shape measurements, and stellar kinematics, we find that these central structures are ubiquitously flattened and rotation-supported with low Sérsic indices ($n \lesssim 1$). This indicates that the central regions are predominantly nuclear disks and bars rather than bulges. Tracking their evolution, we show that these nuclear disks and bars emerge during gas-rich compaction and do not transform into spheroidal and dispersion-dominated systems until $z \lesssim 1$, before which extended stellar disks have already developed. Our results suggest that massive disks can assemble around rotation-supported centers and bulge-deficient massive galaxies may be a common outcome of galaxy evolution.

title: Radio Quasars in the Cosmic Dawn: A Spectroscopic Sample from the DESI Survey
background_knowledge: 类星体是宇宙中最明亮的持续发光天体，其辐射主要由星系中心超大质量黑洞的吸积活动提供能量。在宇宙黎明时期（红移 z>5），高红移类星体是探测早期超大质量黑洞成长与早期宇宙演化的关键探针。部分类星体会产生强大的相对论性物质喷流，在射电波段表现出极高的辐射亮度（即射电噪类星体）。研究此类天体静止系紫外光谱中的宽发射线（如Lyα、CIV）和宽吸收线（BAL）特征，可以揭示黑洞吸积盘风、喷流以及宽线区（BLR）的运动学性质。射电喷流与吸积盘风（外流）之间的物理联系，及其在早期宇宙中的发生与演化机制，是当前活动星系核（AGN）研究领域的重要前沿课题。
contribution: 该工作结合DESI巡天与LOFAR低频射电数据，构建了迄今为止最大的宇宙黎明时期（4.7 < z < 6.7）射电类星体光谱统计样本。研究共证认出83颗由喷流主导的射电类星体（其中26颗为射电噪类星体）。光谱分析表明，射电探测类星体与无射电探测的类星体在CIV速度偏移等复合光谱特征上高度相似，仅Lyα和CIV等值宽略小，并未发现弱线类星体（WLQ）比例显著增加的证据。此外，研究发现宽吸收线（BAL）类星体主要表现为射电宁静，且吸收指数与射电响度无显著相关性，这表明射电喷流与BAL外流是物理上相互独立的现象，并证实了在红移 z~5 时强大的射电喷流机制已经完全确立。
summary: We present the largest statistical spectroscopic sample of radio quasars at 4.7<z<6.7 to date. These have been selected from a dedicated Dark Energy Survey Instrument (DESI) target program and provide a robust sample to study the influence of radio jets on early quasar evolution. Using low-frequency radio data from the LOFAR Two Metre Sky Survey Data Release 3 (LoTSS-DR3) at 144 MHz, we identify 83 high-z radio quasars, 26 of which are classified as radio-loud (5-15% of 646 confirmed high-z quasars, defined as $R = F_{5\text{GHz}}/F_{4400A} >10$). With radio luminosities of $\sim10^{25-28}$ W/Hz, the radio emission in all 83 quasars is expected to be jet-dominated rather than powered by star formation. Analysis of their rest-frame ultra-violet (UV) spectra reveals broadly similar composite spectral properties and CIV velocity shifts compared to radio non-detected quasars. The radio-detected and radio-loud quasars exhibit slightly smaller Ly$α$ and CIV equivalent widths on average, however, we find no significant evidence ($\sim1.3σ$) for a higher fraction of weak-line quasars (WLQs; ~10+/-4% versus ~4+/-1% for radio non-detected quasars).
