We further find that the broad absorption line (BAL) quasars are predominantly radio-quiet, and no correlation is observed between absorption index and radio-loudness, suggesting that radio emission is not produced by the BAL outflows themselves and are physically distinct phenomena. Our results demonstrate that powerful radio jets were already well-established by z~5.

title: EPIMETHEUS: Effective PSF inferred from mosaics
background_knowledge: 在天文观测中，点源函数（Point Spread Function, PSF）描述了光学望远镜系统对未分辨点源（如恒星）的二维空间响应。由于衍射、光学像差以及探测器效应，理想的点源在图像上会扩散成特定形状的光斑。精确掌握PSF对于天体测量、高精度测光、星系形态分析以及弱引力透镜测量等几乎所有天文图像分析工作都至关重要。现代天文深场巡天通常通过叠加不同观测历元、不同观测条件和不同位置角（PAs）的多次曝光来生成高信噪比的拼接图像（mosaics）。这种叠加会导致最终图像的有效点源函数（ePSF）变得极其复杂且存在空间和时间上的叠加效应，使得传统单一图像的PSF提取方法难以适用。
contribution: 本文开发了名为EPIMETHEUS的开源Python库，专门用于管理从初始恒星选择到最终模型生成的完整有效点源函数（ePSF）构建工作流。该软件采用透明的模块化架构，允许用户自定义过滤条件（如方向和光斑集中度）并支持多图像联合处理，成功解决了单视场中亮星不足及多历元拼接图像中复杂的旋转平移叠加问题。此外，作者利用该工具公开发布了哈勃空间望远镜（HST）和韦布空间望远镜（JWST）在COSMOS、UDS、Abell 2744和GOODS-S等著名观测场中各标准滤光片的经验ePSF模型库。
summary: Accurate knowledge of the point spread function (PSF) is essential for a wide range of astronomical applications, from astrometry to precision photometry. However, deriving a robust average effective PSF (ePSF) from astronomical mosaics is particularly challenging due to the superposition of exposures taken at different epochs, under different observing conditions, and with varying position angles (PAs). To address this issue, we present EPIMETHEUS, an open-source Python library designed to manage the entire ePSF construction workflow, from initial star selection to final model generation. Built with a modular architecture, EPIMETHEUS avoids black-box methodologies, ensuring full transparency and giving the user complete control over the stellar sample to use for the ePSF building to meet specific scientific requirements. The software can process multiple images or mosaics simultaneously to retrieve the ePSF, a crucial feature when individual fields lack a sufficient number of bright, unsaturated stars. Candidate stars can be automatically filtered based on orientation and light concentration, with options for manually excluding stars through a semi-automatic visual inspection. Although EPIMETHEUS is specifically optimised to handle the roto-translation complexities inherent to multi-epoch mosaics, it is versatile and can be equally applied to derive ePSFs from simpler, single-orientation images where rotational corrections are not required. Finally, to demonstrate the software's capabilities and provide an immediate resource, we release empirical ePSFs for standard HST and JWST filters across the COSMOS, UDS, Abell 2744, and GOODS-S fields.

title: Euclid Quick Data Release (Q1): Disc breaks highlight the structural evolution of galaxies through time
background_knowledge: 盘星系（如典型的旋涡星系）的表面亮度通常随半径向外呈现指数衰减。然而，在绝大多数情况下，这种径向分布并非完美的单一指数形式，而是在某个特定半径处发生斜率的明显改变，这一现象被称为“星系盘折断”（disc breaks）。根据斜率变化的特征，星系径向亮度轮廓通常被分为三类：I型（纯指数分布，无折断）、II型（向下弯折或截断，外部变陡，通常认为与恒星形成阈值或星系内部长期演化如恒星径向迁移有关）和III型（向上弯折或反截断，外部变平缓，常与星系并合等外部环境效应及恒星晕有关）。通过统计不同红移处星系盘折断的类型分布及其结构参数（如折断半径、标泽长度等），天文学家可以重构星系的质量组装历史与结构演化规律。然而，由于测量星系暗弱的外围区域需要极高的图像分辨率和观测深度，过去针对星系盘折断的大样本统计研究主要局限于近邻宇宙（低红移）。欧几里得（Euclid）空间望远镜凭借其卓越的巡天深度与高分辨率，为首次对中高红移（如 $z \sim 1$）星系外围结构进行大样本统计研究提供了可能。
contribution: 本研究利用欧几里得望远镜快速数据发布（Euclid Q1）的观测数据，开发了一套自动化的数据分析流水线，对红移高达 $z=1$ 的8748个盘星系提取了表面亮度轮廓并进行了精确的结构参数拟合与分类（I型、II型、III型及复合型）。利用其中4385个分类可靠的子样本，研究团队首次对过去50亿年间星系盘折断类型的演化进行了具备统计学意义的稳健测量。核心发现指出，星系盘折断类型的比例随宇宙时发生了显著演化：在低红移（近邻宇宙）中，代表内部长期演化的II型轮廓占主导地位（达50%）；而随着回溯时间的增加（趋向 $z \sim 1$），与环境效应相关的III型以及复合型（II+III）的出现频率显著上升，在 $z \sim 1$ 时各占约30%。这一演化趋势为星系结构演化的物理图像提供了强有力的观测证据，即：随着星系逐渐成熟，星系内部的长期演化（secular processes）逐渐取代了外部环境效应，成为主导星系结构发育的关键机制。
summary: Changes in the slope of the radial surface brightness profiles of disc galaxies, or disc breaks, encode valuable information about the processes driving disc formation and growth. Until now, due to the resolution and depth required, statistical studies of break types have been limited mostly to the local Universe. We aim to study the structural properties and redshift evolution of disc breaks in a large and statistically representative sample of galaxies out to redshift z=1 using the superb depth and resolution of Euclid. We develop an automatic pipeline to extract and analyse surface brightness profiles of 8748 disc galaxies selected from the Euclid Q1 dataset. The pipeline includes advanced masking, surface brightness profile extraction, integrated photometry and structural parameter measurements, and piecewise modelling to classify galaxies into Types I (pure exponential), Type II (down-bending), Type III (up-bending), and composite break (e.g., Type~II+III, Type~II+II, etc) profiles. We quantify structural parameters such as scale lengths, break radii, and surface brightness levels, and analyse their distributions and redshift dependence. Our automatic method produces reliable masks and deep surface brightness profiles, and classifies galaxy profiles with an estimated accuracy of 70%. Using a subsample of 4385 galaxies with reliable classifications, we find that the most common profiles are Types II, II+III, I, and III. We find substantial evolution in the fraction of disc breaks with time. Type II profiles dominate at low redshift (50%), while Types III and II+III profiles increase in frequency with lookback time, reaching 30% each at z~1. Our study provides the first statistically robust measurement of the evolution of disc break types over 5 Gyr. The observed trends support a scenario in which secular processes replace environmental influences as galaxies mature.

title: JWST evidence for a sharp "Cosmic Daybreak" at z = 15
background_knowledge: 在宇宙学标准模型（ΛCDM）中，大爆炸之后的“黑暗时代”随着第一代星系和恒星的渐进式形成而终结，这一漫长且逐渐演化的时期被称为“宇宙黎明”（Cosmic Dawn）。在此框架下，冷暗物质粒子驱动结构从小尺度向大尺度分层形成。然而，波动暗物质（Wave Dark Matter, ψDM，如受弦轴子启发的超轻玻色子或玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚态）模型提出了不同的物理图像：超轻暗物质的德布罗意波压强会在极早期抵抗引力坍缩，抑制小尺度结构的形成，直到暗物质晕达到临界的“金斯质量”（Jeans mass）后，星系才会突然大量形成，从而产生一个陡峭的“宇宙破晓”（Cosmic Daybreak）。詹姆斯·韦布空间望远镜（JWST）对极高红移宇宙的观测能力，为检验冷暗物质与超轻玻色子暗物质模型提供了前所未有的窗口。
contribution: 本文基于JWST对高达z=14.5的明亮年轻星系的观测，指出这些高红移星系的恒星年龄在z=15时趋近于零，且更高红移处缺乏恒星形成证据。这种陡峭的“宇宙破晓”现象与ΛCDM模型预测的渐进式演化及低光度特征相悖，但完美印证了波动暗物质（ψDM）模型的预测。作者计算得出，在z=15时克服波压强所需的金斯质量为4×10^9 M_⊙，由此推导出的轻玻色子暗物质质量为2.2(-0.3/+0.4)×10^-22 eV，该数值与基于引力透镜异常和矮星系的独立估算高度一致。研究强调，随着JWST数据的进一步积累，最高红移星系的光度分布将为判别暗物质是重粒子还是超轻玻色子提供决定性的检验。
summary: Luminous young galaxies have been uncovered with relative ease by JWST, extending to z=14.5, so it is puzzling that deeper spectroscopy of fainter candidates now finds only interlopers. This redshift `ìmpasse" is underscored by the measured stellar ages of these high-z galaxies, which we show converge to zero by z=15, with a marked absence of earlier star-formation. Taken literally, such a late transition from the Dark Ages to luminous galaxies is unlike the gradual Cosmic Dawn of standard LCDM, but does confirm a key prediction of Wave Dark Matter, $ψ$DM, as a Bose-Einstein condensate. The de Broglie wave pressure resists gravity until a substantial Jeans mass of $4\times 10^9M_\odot$ is overcome at z$=$15, corresponding to a light boson $m_ψ=2.2_{-0.3}^{+0.4} \times 10^{-22}$eV, and similar to independent estimates from lensing anomalies and dwarf galaxies. Furthermore, the substantial luminosities of the highest redshift galaxies appear to converge to the initial Jeans scale of $ψ$DM, whereas LCDM predictions extend to lower luminosities and larger ages than observed. These contrasting predictions can be definitively tested as JWST observations accumulate, with diametric implications for Dark Matter as heavy particles beyond the Standard Model, or ultra-light bosons motivated by the String Axiverse.

title: Probing Exoplanetary Chemistry with Ariel: Scientific Priorities and Observational Strategies
background_knowledge: 在系外行星研究领域，随着观测精度的提升，研究重心已从单纯的搜寻与发现转移到了对行星大气特征的精细表征。系外行星大气的化学成分极其多样，且往往处于非热力学平衡状态。在气态巨行星和类海王星行星中，诸如大气垂直混合、受恒星辐射驱动的光化学反应以及全球大气环流等物理过程，会导致大气化学成分显著偏离热力学平衡预期。为了理解这些复杂现象背后的物理机制及行星的演化历史，天文学界正致力于从对单一目标的孤立研究，转向针对不同行星族群进行大规模、同源的统计学分析，这极度依赖于诸如欧洲空间局（ESA）Ariel任务等未来空间望远镜提供的大样本、高精度光谱巡天数据。
contribution: 本文系统阐述了ESA Ariel空间望远镜在系外行星大气化学方向的科学优先事项与观测策略。作为Ariel化学工作组的核心成果，论文凝练了该领域的关键科学问题，包括非平衡化学的驱动机制、含硫与含磷物种的作用、恒星活动的影响、光化学霾前体物的形成，以及不同类型和年龄宿主恒星下行星大气的化学演化。针对每个科学主题，研究制定了相应的观测策略，并从任务候选样本中挑选了代表性目标以展示Ariel的光谱探测潜力。该工作通过建立大尺度观测与大气预测模型之间的联系，为优化Ariel任务的目标选择提供了理论支撑，为实现系外行星族群级别的统计学研究奠定了基础。
summary: Over the past two decades, increasingly precise observations have revealed that exoplanet atmospheres are chemically diverse and often far from equilibrium, with processes such as vertical mixing, photochemistry, and atmospheric circulation producing significant departures from thermochemical expectations. As large surveys across a wide range of planets begin to uncover population-level chemical trends, a coherent interpretation of these patterns remains elusive, particularly for gas giants and Neptune-like planets where disequilibrium processes likely dominate. The ESA Ariel mission will provide the first homogeneous, statistically significant atmospheric dataset for nearly a thousand exoplanets, offering an unprecedented opportunity to investigate the origins of chemical diversity across planetary populations. This white paper highlights central scientific questions for understanding atmospheric chemistry and recognized as priorities for the community. These questions span the mechanisms driving disequilibrium chemistry, the role of sulfur- and phosphorus-bearing species, the influence of stellar activity, the formation of haze precursors, and the chemical evolution of atmospheres around stars of different ages and types. Because these topics connect chemistry, physics, and planetary evolution, they form the core focus of the Ariel Chemistry Working Group, which synthesizes current knowledge and identifies the diagnostics best addressed by Ariel's spectral capabilities. For each theme, we outline observational strategies and representative targets already included in the Mission Candidate Sample, illustrating Ariel's ability to address these questions. By linking large-scale observations to predictive atmospheric models, this work supports refinement of Ariel's target selection and enables population-level studies that will transform our understanding of planetary atmospheres.

title: Jodrell Bank and the British Astronomical Association: The Making of a Generation of Scientists
background_knowledge: 射电天文学是现代天文学的重要分支，其起源与第二次世界大战期间雷达技术的发展密切相关。1945年，伯纳德·洛弗尔（Bernard Lovell）在英国乔德雷尔班克（Jodrell Bank）利用雷达设备成功探测到流星余迹的回波，这一事件不仅开启了流星天文学的新纪元，也为射电天文学的建立奠定了物理与技术基础。在射电天文学的成型期（20世纪40年代中后期），专业研究机构与传统的业余或半专业天文组织（如英国天文协会 BAA）之间存在着密切的互动，这种社群间的交流对早期天文人才的培养、观测数据的积累以及多学科交叉的拓展起到了至关重要的历史作用。
contribution: 本文考察了1946至1951年的成型期间，乔德雷尔班克新兴射电研究团队与英国天文协会（BAA）之间的紧密联系。论文详细梳理了连接这两个社群的关键人物的贡献，特别回顾了Michael Ovenden、Gerald Hawkins、John Clegg、John Davies、Victor Hughes和Mary Almond等六位BAA成员的生平与科学生涯。研究指出，这一代科学家展现了非凡的科研才华，其后续的科学成就不仅极大推动了射电天文学的发展，还广泛延伸至行星科学、古地磁学、考古地磁学以及计算机科学等多个领域。
summary: The discovery of radar echoes from meteor trains at Jodrell Bank in 1945 marked the beginning of a new era in meteor astronomy and laid the foundations for the subsequent development of radio astronomy. This paper examines the close relationship between Bernard Lovell's emerging research group at Jodrell Bank and the British Astronomical Association (BAA) during the formative years, 1946-1951. It explores the contributions of the individuals who connected these two communities. Particular attention is given to the lives and scientific careers of Michael Ovenden, Gerald Hawkins, John Clegg, John Davies, Victor Hughes and Mary Almond, all of whom were BAA members. Their later achievements demonstrate the remarkable talents of this generation of scientists, whose work extended across radio astronomy, planetary science, palaeomagnetism, archaeomagnetism and computer science.

title: Dark Matter-Induced Stellar Oscillations in the de Broglie Regime
background_knowledge: 超轻暗物质（Ultralight Dark Matter, ULDM）是暗物质的重要候选模型之一。该模型假设暗物质粒子质量极小（如$10^{-22}$ eV量级），使得其德布罗意波长达到宏观甚至星系尺度，表现出显著的波动性。在星系晕中，ULDM场的干涉效应会产生空间上不均匀且随时间变化的引力势。另一方面，恒星（如太阳）并非绝对的刚体，其内部存在复杂的声波和重力波本征振荡模式（星震学）。理论上，如果恒星处于这种波动的暗物质背景中，随时间变化的微小引力势可作为一种外部周期性或随机性微扰，从而激发出特定的恒星振荡模式。这种机制为利用恒星作为巨型探测器来寻找暗物质信号提供了一种潜在的天体物理途径。
contribution: 本文深入研究了在德布罗意机制下，由超轻暗物质（ULDM）时变引力势驱动的恒星振荡现象。作者指出，恒星的振荡响应主要取决于ULDM场的相干时间与恒星模式阻尼时间之间的比值。当暗物质场的退相干时间短于恒星阻尼时间时，ULDM表现为一种随机源，主要激发低于特征德布罗意频率的振荡模式并压制高频模式；而在长相干时间机制下，特定的恒星模式能够被共振激发。然而，通过将该理论模型应用于太阳振荡，研究发现预期信号强度远低于当前的观测灵敏度，并推断其他恒星同样极难在当前技术条件下提供可观测的暗物质诱发振荡信号。
summary: We investigate stellar oscillations driven by the time-dependent gravitational potential of ultralight dark matter (ULDM) in the de Broglie regime. The response is controlled by the ratio of the ULDM coherence time to the stellar mode damping time. When the field decoheres faster than the damping time, ULDM acts as a stochastic source that excites modes below a characteristic de Broglie frequency, while higher-frequency modes are suppressed. In the opposite, long-coherence regime, individual modes can be resonantly driven. Focusing on solar oscillations, we find a signal far below current sensitivity, and estimate that other stars are similarly unlikely to provide observable signals.

title: Fermionic cosmic strings in dynamical Chern-Simons gravity
background_knowledge: 在早期宇宙的演化过程中，随着宇宙的膨胀与冷却，基本相互作用场会经历一系列对称性自发破缺的相变。在这些相变过程中，不同因果区域的真空状态可能无法完全对齐，从而在空间中遗留下线状的拓扑缺陷，即‘宇宙弦’（Cosmic Strings）。另一方面，为了探究广义相对论在极高能或量子尺度下的局限性，理论物理学家发展了多种修正引力模型。其中，动态陈-西蒙斯（Chern-Simons, dCS）引力是一种引入了宇称破坏（Parity Violation）的引力理论，常作为弦理论等量子引力候选者的低能有效理论出现。研究宇宙弦在具有手征反常或超越广义相对论的修正引力中的行为，对于探索极早期宇宙的物理规律、量子引力效应以及引力反常现象的消除机制具有核心的基础物理学价值。
contribution: 本文探讨了在动态陈-西蒙斯（dCS）引力的费米子紫外完备化模型中，由手征相变产生的宇宙弦等拓扑缺陷。研究发现，在手征对称性破缺尺度之下，积分掉有能隙的体模式会产生引力Chern-Simons耦合，进而改变了相变产生的宇宙弦解。这种修正后的弦度规由广义的Callan-Harvey费米子零模解所支持，其中零模产生的零流（null current）为宇称破坏提供了物理机制。作者在弱耦合与弱引力近似下，推导出了该外部度规的领头阶降阶dCS修正。此外，论文探讨了dCS引力中一般弦构型的有效作用量描述，并指出引力Pontryagin项提供了消除手征世界面理论引力反常所必需的反常流入（anomaly inflow）机制。
summary: We investigate topological defects produced by a chiral phase transition in a fermionic ultraviolet completion of dynamical Chern-Simons (dCS) gravity. The model contains a complex scalar field with a chiral Yukawa coupling to fermions. Below the chiral symmetry breaking scale, integrating out the gapped bulk modes produces a gravitational Chern-Simons coupling which, we argue, modifies cosmic string solutions from the phase transition. The resulting corrected string metric is supported by a generalization of the Callan-Harvey fermionic zero mode solution, in which the null current generated by these zero modes provides a mechanism for parity violation. In the weak-coupling and weak-gravity regime, we derive the leading order-reduced dCS correction to this exterior metric. We also discuss the effective action description for generic string configurations in dCS gravity. The gravitational Pontryagin term provides the anomaly inflow required to cancel the gravitational anomaly of the chiral worldsheet theory.

title: Big Bang Nucleosynthesis as a Probe of First-Order Phase Transitions
background_knowledge: 宇宙极早期可能经历过一阶相变（First-Order Phase Transitions, FOPTs），这一剧烈的物理过程会通过真空气泡的成核、膨胀与碰撞释放大量潜热（重加热过程），并产生随机的引力波背景辐射。原初核合成（BBN）发生在宇宙大爆炸后几分钟到二十分钟左右，是形成氘、氦和锂等轻元素的关键时期，其产物丰度高度依赖于重子-光子比或重子-熵比。如果宇宙的重子不对称性（Baryogenesis）产生于一阶相变之前，相变过程中随机重加热引发的局部温度不均匀性会转化为重子-光子比的空间涨落。这种不均匀性会影响核合成的反应速率，从而在当今轻元素丰度的观测中留下印记。近年来，脉冲星计时阵列（如NANOGrav）探测到的纳赫兹引力波信号常被尝试用早期宇宙的一阶相变来解释，这使得结合引力波与轻元素丰度等多信使手段来限制极早期宇宙物理（如相变参数和重子生成的时机）成为重要的研究范式。
contribution: 本文拓展了利用原初核合成（BBN）探测一阶相变的理论框架，将重加热诱导的重子-熵比涨落、有限气泡统计的相变时间功率谱与BBN时期的核子扩散效应相结合。研究发现，当相变成核温度位于 $10^{-2}\,{\rm GeV} \lesssim T_{n} \lesssim 10^{2}\,{\rm GeV}$ 时，精确的氘丰度测量能在 $1\sigma$ 水平上排除具有大潜热和长持续时间的相变参数空间（该限制随 $T_n$ 升高、扩散效应增强而减弱）。此外，该限制有效地排除了能够解释NANOGrav引力波信号的部分一阶相变参数空间，从而得出结论：在用相变解释该引力波信号的模型中，重子不对称性不能简单地发生在相变之前，而必须在重加热之后或相变期间产生。该工作证明了结合引力波观测与轻元素丰度测量可以有效约束早期宇宙重子生成的时机。
summary: Supercooled cosmological first-order phase transitions (FOPTs) generate a large temperature inhomogeneity due to their stochastic reheating process. If a baryon asymmetry production predates the FOPT and is conserved during it, the temperature contrast is transferred onto the baryon-to-photon ratio $η$ or the baryon-to-entropy ratio $Y_{B}$, producing an inhomogeneity probed by big bang nucleosynthesis (BBN). We extend a recent formalism for this effect by including the reheating dependence of the induced $Y_{B}$ fluctuations, combining the transition-time power spectrum from finite-bubble statistics with proton and neutron diffusion at the BBN epoch. When the nucleation temperature is in the range $10^{-2}\,{\rm GeV} \lesssim T_{n} \lesssim 10^{2}\,{\rm GeV}$, the precise measurement of deuterium abundances disfavors parameter regions with a sizable latent heat and a long transition duration at the $1 σ$ level. The bound weakens towards higher $T_{n}$ as diffusion becomes more efficient. We further show that this bound disfavors FOPT parameter regions compatible with the NANOGrav gravitational wave signal. This conclusion assumes that the baryon asymmetry predates the transition and that the fluctuation spectrum remains valid down to sub-bubble scales. Therefore, in such FOPT explanations of the NANOGrav signal, the baryon asymmetry cannot simply predate the transition. It can instead be generated after reheating or during the transition if the local baryon production tracks the local entropy injection. As a result, the timing of baryogenesis may be constrained by combining gravitational wave observations with light element abundance measurements.

title: The birth and fate of stellar clumps in super-early galaxies
background_knowledge: 韦布空间望远镜（JWST）的最新观测揭示，在宇宙极早期（红移 z>6）的星系中普遍存在极端致密的恒星团块。在星系形成与演化的物理图景中，早期星系通常富含冷气体，这些气体在冷却坍缩后往往会形成旋转支撑的气体盘。当盘面的局部引力不稳定性（通常用Toomre Q参数衡量，Q<1表示不稳定）克服了内部热压强与旋转支撑时，气体盘会发生碎裂，从而在原位（in-situ）引发剧烈的恒星形成，诞生大质量致密恒星团块。同时，新生的大质量恒星会通过星风、超新星爆发及光致电离等形式向周围星际介质注入能量与动量（即恒星反馈），这对团块的后续生长、寿命以及整个星系的结构演化起着至关重要的调节作用。探究这些早期星系内部致密团块的起源与命运，是理解宇宙黎明时期星系演化与组装历史的核心课题。
contribution: 本研究利用高分辨率辐射流体动力学模拟（最高空间分辨率达3.6 pc），追踪了一个孤立星系在红移 z=16 至 12.5 期间（演化1亿年）的过程，系统探讨了超早期星系中致密恒星团块的原位形成机制及恒星反馈的调节作用。核心发现包括：(1) 气体迅速形成旋转盘，并在Toomre不稳定区域通过引力碎裂机制优先形成恒星团块，其恒星质量、有效半径和表面密度均与JWST在 z>6 处观测到的团块高度吻合。(2) 恒星反馈未能阻止团块的初始诞生，但会使累积恒星质量减少30-40%，大幅降低团块内的气体保留量，并抑制大质量团块的生成。(3) 团块随后会经历迁移、相互作用、潮汐剥离直至消散，其质量函数呈现斜率为-1.88的幂律分布，与观测极为一致。(4) 团块对星系整体恒星质量和本征紫外光度的贡献率随演化时间显著下降。研究证明，富气致密盘的引力碎裂是早期宇宙致密恒星系统形成的可行途径，而其后续演化与命运主要由恒星反馈和内部动力学主导。
summary: (Abridged) JWST has revealed extremely compact stellar clumps in galaxies at z>6, but their formation mechanism and subsequent evolution remain uncertain. We investigate whether such systems can form in-situ through the fragmentation of an early galactic disk and how stellar feedback regulates their properties. We perform a suite of radiation-hydrodynamical simulations of an isolated galaxy ("Ninfea_blu"), with $\rm M_{vir}=1.5\times10^{10} M_\odot$, evolved for 100 Myr from z=16 to 12.5 with a maximum spatial resolution of 3.6 pc. In all cases, the gas rapidly forms a rotationally supported disk, reaches a peak star formation rate of $10-15\rm M_\odot yr^{-1}$, and fragments into dense stellar clumps. Toomre-unstable regions ($Q_{\rm gas}<1$) appear before the onset of star formation, and the first stellar structures form preferentially within these regions, supporting a Toomre-like gravitational fragmentation pathway.The clumps have stellar masses of $10^6-2\times10^8\,M_\odot$, effective radii of 7-50 pc, and surface densities of $0.2-3\times10^4\rm M_\odot pc^{-2}$, overlapping much of the parameter space occupied by observed z>6 clumps. Feedback reduces the cumulative stellar mass by 30-40%, lowers the gas mass retained within clumps by ~1 dex, and suppresses their high-mass tail without preventing their initial formation. Clumps subsequently migrate, interact, undergo tidal stripping, and disperse. The clump mass function produces a power law slope of -1.88, which aligns closely with observations. Moreover, their contributions to the stellar mass and intrinsic UV luminosity decline from 0.41 and 0.40 at 20 Myr to 0.13 and 0.10 at 100 Myr, respectively. We conclude that fragmentation of compact, gas-rich disks provides a viable origin for many of the dense stellar systems observed in the early Universe, while feedback and internal dynamics primarily regulate their growth and fate.

title: Waiting in the wings: extended emission GRBs from high latitude emission and jet expansion
background_knowledge: 伽马射线暴（GRB）是宇宙中最剧烈的爆发事件之一，按持续时间通常分为由大质量恒星坍缩引起的长暴和由致密双星（如双中子星）并合引起的短暴。标准双中子星并合后的中心引擎吸积时标通常极短（通常在2秒以内）。然而，观测中发现了一类特殊的短暴，它们在初始的短脉冲之后，伴随着长达10到100秒的延展辐射（Extended Emission, EE）。这种长时标的高能辐射远超预期的标准吸积盘寿命，对现有的致密星并合及喷流产生机制构成了严峻挑战。为解释这一现象，天文学家致力于研究复杂的喷流动力学模型，如喷流结构的横向演化、洛伦兹因子的变化以及高纬度辐射（即来自观测者视线外侧区域的延迟辐射）等物理效应。
contribution: 本文提出了一个解析形式的薄壳层结构化喷流模型，旨在缓解延展辐射时标与双中子星并合吸积时标之间的矛盾。研究表明，动态演化的喷流结构（早期辐射由高洛伦兹因子的狭窄结构化喷流产生，晚期辐射由低洛伦兹因子的宽平顶喷流主导）能够成功重现EE GRB的光变现象。模型中所有发射壳层均由0.1太阳质量的吸积盘在并合后2秒的短时间内发射产生，且空间分辨的不透明度检验确认了辐射区保持光学薄。该模型生成的光变曲线与Swift卫星探测到的典型EE暴（211211A、211227A和060614）吻合良好，尽管其能谱演化速度较211211A的实际观测偏慢。此外，参数空间探索表明该模型也能产生标准短暴的光变曲线，展示了其统一解释不同类型短伽马暴的潜力。
summary: The process powering extended emission (EE) Gamma Ray-Bursts (GRBs) from compact object mergers is a debated problem due to their observed prompt emission timescales of 10 to 100s, far in excess of the expected accretion timescales following a binary neutron star (BNS) merger. Here, we present an analytical thin shell structured jet model designed to alleviate this tension. We show that a changing jet structure in which early emission is produced by a high Lorentz factor narrow, structured jet and later emission comes from a wider, lower Lorentz factor tophat-like jet can successfully reproduce the EE GRB phenomenology. All emitting shells are powered by a $0.1$ $M_{\odot}$ accretion torus and launched within a time window of 2s after merger. Spatially-resolved opacity checks confirm that our emission sites remain optically thin, in part due to the spectral softness associated with EE. We present light curves from our model compared to representative EE bursts detected by Swift: GRBs 211211A, 211227A and 060614. While our light curves provide good matches to the data, our spectra do not evolve fast enough when compared to the well-measured spectral evolution observed in GRB 211211A. We discuss an update to the model incorporating inherent spectral evolution in the shells as future work. We also show a parameter exploration of the model and identify a parameter range within which standard short GRB-like light curves could be produced, showcasing the ability of the model to produce short bursts with and without EE.

title: Axions and the RR Lyrae Period-Luminosity Relation
background_knowledge: 轴子（Axion）是为解决量子色动力学（QCD）强CP问题而提出的一种假想基本粒子，同时也是冷暗物质的热门候选者之一。天琴座RR型变星是一类处于水平分支阶段的脉动变星，其光变周期与绝对光度之间存在明确的周光关系（Period-Luminosity Relation, PLR），是测量星系和球状星团距离的重要“标准烛光”。在恒星演化理论中，如果轴子存在，它可以通过与电子的耦合在红巨星的高温高密度核心中产生并直接逃逸，从而带走大量能量（即辐射冷却效应）。这种额外的冷却机制会推迟核心氦闪的发生，导致恒星在点火时积累更大的核心质量，进而使得后续演化出的水平分支星（包括RR型变星）具有更高的光度。因此，利用标准烛光的精确观测数据，可以对轴子等新物理粒子的参数空间进行严格限制。
contribution: 本文深入探讨了轴子对天琴座RR型变星周光关系（PLR）的具体影响。研究证实，红巨星阶段由轴子-电子耦合引起的冷却效应会增加核心质量，使得产生的RR型变星更加明亮，从而导致其周光关系的零点系统性地向高光度方向偏移。研究团队结合球状星团M3的年龄和化学组成，利用恒星演化和脉动模型模拟了其RR型变星群体，并将其合成的Ks波段周光关系与实际观测数据进行了对比。结果表明，当轴子-电子耦合参数 α_26 ≡ 10^26 g_{ae}^2 / 4π = 0.5 时，由轴子引起的理论周光关系零点偏移量与目前M3绝对零点校准的观测不确定度相当，这为利用恒星演化及脉动特性限制轴子性质提供了重要的量化参考。
summary: We investigate the impact of axions on the period-luminosity relation (PLR) of RR Lyrae stars. During the red giant branch phase, emission through the electron coupling cools the core, increasing its mass at ignition. The larger core produces more luminous horizontal-branch stars, systematically shifting the zero point of the RR Lyrae PLR toward brighter magnitudes. We model the RR Lyrae population of the globular cluster M3 using stellar evolution and pulsation calculations tailored to its age and composition, and compare the resulting synthetic $K_s$-band PLR with observations. For $α_{26}\equiv 10^{26}g_{ae}^2/4π=0.5$, the axion-induced shift in the predicted PLR is comparable to the current uncertainty in the absolute M3 zero-point calibration.

title: A multi-telescope fit to the FRB population, allowing for FRB repetition
background_knowledge: 快速射电暴（Fast Radio Burst, FRB）是宇宙中持续时间仅为毫秒量级的极其明亮的射电瞬变源，具有河外甚至宇宙学起源。FRB 的一个关键观测特征是色散量（Dispersion Measure, DM），它反映了射电信号沿视线传播路径上的自由电子柱密度。通过研究红移与色散量（$z$-DM）的关系，天文学家可以探究星系际介质的分布并约束 FRB 的距离。目前 FRB 领域的一个核心争议是：部分 FRB 会重复爆发（重复暴），而大多数目前仅被观测到一次爆发（非重复暴）。这两者是来源于同一种物理机制（仅是爆发频率或活跃度不同），还是代表了两类完全不同的前身星族群？为了打破观测选择效应带来的简并，需要结合全球多个不同观测频段和灵敏度的射电望远镜数据，对 FRB 族群的爆发率、能量函数等进行联合统计建模。
contribution: 本文对 FRB 族群进行了全面的红移-色散量（$z$-DM）分析，并引入了简单的幂律重复率模型。研究假设所有 FRB 均来自同一个内禀物理族群，利用来自 ASKAP、Parkes、DSA、FAST、MeerKAT 以及 CHIME 第一版星表的多望远镜联合数据对族群参数进行了拟合。研究在 $10^{39}$ erg 能量阈值以上，将最小重复率限制为 $R_{\mathrm{min}}=-4.23^{+1.10}_{-1.74}$ 天$^{-1}$，最大重复率限制为 $R_{\mathrm{max}} \gtrsim 1$ 天$^{-1}$，重复率指数限制为 $R_\gamma=-2.20^{+0.12}_{-0.22}$。这些参数与其他 FRB 参数没有显示出显著的相关性。该工作的结果不仅与 CHIME 的 DM 分布以及观测到的全天重复暴/非重复暴比例保持自洽，还提供了 FRB 能量函数和宿主星系参数的最新估计。
summary: Fast radio bursts (FRBs) are millisecond-duration radio pulses with extragalactic origins. A majority of FRBs have only had a single pulse detected from them; however, an increasing number have been identified as repeaters. Here we present a full redshift -- dispersion measure ($z$-DM) analysis including a simple power-law model of repetition rates. We assume all FRBs are drawn from the same intrinsic population and fit these FRB population parameters using data from ASKAP, Murriyang (Parkes), DSA, FAST, MeerKAT and CHIME catalogue 1. We do not utilise data from CHIME catalogue 2 yet, as we cannot robustly identify all repeaters in the sample. We constrain the minimum repetition rate above $10^{39}$ erg to $R_{\mathrm{min}}=-4.23^{+1.10}_{-1.74}$ d$^{-1}$, the maximum repetition rate to $R_{\mathrm{max}} \gtrsim 1$ d$^{-1}$ and the repetition rate index to $R_γ=-2.20^{+0.12}_{-0.22}$. These parameters do not show significant correlation with any other FRB parameters. Our values are an improvement on existing results and are self-consistent with the DM distribution of CHIME and observed ratios of repeaters to non-repeaters across the sky. We also provide updated estimates of the FRB energy function and host galaxy parameters.

title: Increasing Sensitivity to Trailed Solar System Objects in Archival JWST NIRCam Imaging with Group Differencing
background_knowledge: 詹姆斯·韦伯空间望远镜（JWST）的近红外相机（NIRCam）在单次曝光中通常采用非破坏性读取模式（即“向上演进”或 up-the-ramp 采样），标准数据处理流水线通过拟合这些累积读取数据的斜率来生成单张深场图像。然而，太阳系小天体（SSSBs，如小行星或柯伊伯带天体）在长时间曝光期间会相对背景恒星发生明显的自行。这种运动导致小天体在单张合成图像中呈现为“拖尾（trailed）”状态，将其有限的光子分散到了更多像素上，从而引入了更多背景噪声，严重降低了信噪比（SNR），使得暗弱的移动天体极难被探测和识别。
contribution: 本论文提出了一种基于“组差分（group differencing）”的技术来提升 JWST 归档数据中拖尾太阳系天体的探测灵敏度。研究团队将传统的累积读取数据转换为一系列较短曝光的组差分图像时间序列，从而有效缩短了单张图像中的拖尾长度。通过沿天体运动轨迹对这些差分图像进行广义最小二乘拟合，能够以更高的信噪比恢复源流量。研究不仅在13个真实归档天体上验证了该方法，还通过注入/恢复模拟证明，在典型的 JWST 曝光时长下，该技术可将移动天体的探测灵敏度大幅提升约 1.1 至 1.4 等，为在 JWST 归档巡天数据中搜寻暗弱太阳系小天体提供了强有力的工具。
summary: The JWST archive contains thousands of NIRCam exposures distributed across the sky. Small solar system bodies (SSSBs) are present in many of these fields, but are often trailed and more difficult to detect. The standard pipeline produces a single image by fitting a slope to a sequence of $N$ cumulative ``up-the-ramp" groups of the detector. Thus, each JWST image comprises a time series of cumulative reads. We demonstrate that transforming the ramp into a series of group difference images reduces the per-image trail length of moving sources, producing an $(N-1)$-group photometrically calibrated time series from an $N$-group integration. This enables higher-cadence trajectory-based searches using as few as a single JWST exposure. A generalized least-squares fit of the group difference images along the trajectory of a moving source recovers the source flux at higher SNR when compared to the ramp fit, with the improvement scaling with the reduction in trailing. We validate our procedure on 13 moving objects detected in archival JWST NIRCam images. To estimate our sensitivity increase, we perform an injection/recovery simulation on the JWST imagery. Trailed moving objects recovered via group differencing show higher SNRs, improving completeness to moving sources compared to standard calibrations. For typical integration lengths of $N=4$ or $6$ for archival JWST/NIRCam exposures in the ecliptic, group differencing yields sensitivity gains between $\sim 1.1$--$1.4$ mag, based on simulation results. This method significantly increases the sensitivity of archival JWST surveys to trailed SSSBs.

title: Dark Transport Erases Baryon Inhomogeneity from Supercooled Phase Transitions
background_knowledge: 在宇宙极早期的膨胀与冷却过程中，可能会经历物理真空的相变。其中，过冷相变（Supercooled Phase Transitions）不仅有望产生可观测的随机引力波背景，其相变气泡的动力学过程还可能导致宇宙中重子不对称性（即正反物质的微小数量差异）在空间上出现巨大的不均匀分布。如果这种不均匀性在太初核合成（BBN）发生前未能被扩散过程抹平，将导致理论预测的轻元素丰度与天文观测产生严重冲突。对于发生于TeV能标以下的早期相变，普通重子的扩散速度往往过慢，难以有效消除此类不均匀性。为解决该挑战并解释物质起源，引入暗区（Dark-sector）粒子和暗生成（Darkogenesis）机制成为了当前连接粒子物理与早期宇宙演化的重要研究范式。
contribution: 本文提出并证明了‘暗生成’（darkogenesis）机制能够自然解决由过冷相变引发的重子不均匀性问题。研究指出，如果相变首先在暗区粒子中产生不对称性，随后再转移给可见重子，由于暗区粒子在衰变前能比普通重子传播更远的距离，可以在重子不对称性确立之前有效抹平空间的不均匀性。作者推导了在扩散和无碰撞传输两种机制下实现高效抹平的物理条件，并将其转化为对暗区相互作用参数的限制。以重加热温度约为1 GeV、相变参数β/H约10、暗粒子寿命为0.1秒的典型暗相变模型为例，研究证实该机制在合理的相互作用范围内即可有效运作。此外，论文指出在相变前进行重子生成会面临过冷稀释和产生不均匀性的双重挑战，从而确立了相变驱动的‘暗生成’结合暗区传输抹平效应是一个高度自洽的理论框架。
summary: Supercooled phase transitions can generate observable gravitational waves, but their bubble dynamics may also imprint large spatial inhomogeneities in the baryon asymmetry. For phase transitions below the TeV scale, ordinary baryon diffusion can be too slow to erase such inhomogeneities before Big Bang Nucleosynthesis, potentially leading to stringent constraints from the observed light-element abundances. We show that this problem can be naturally avoided in darkogenesis scenarios, where the phase transition first generates an asymmetry in a dark-sector particle that is subsequently transferred to visible baryons. The dark-sector particle can travel over much larger distances than ordinary baryons before decaying, erasing the inhomogeneity before the baryon asymmetry is established. We derive the conditions for efficient erasure in both the diffusive and collisionless transport regimes and translate them into constraints on the dark-sector interactions. For a representative dark phase transition with a reheating temperature of $\mathcal{O}(1) \,\mathrm{GeV}$, $β/H \simeq 10$, and a dark-sector particle lifetime of $0.1\,\mathrm{s}$, we find that the inhomogeneity is efficiently erased for a viable range of the interactions. Importantly, baryogenesis before the phase transition is challenged both by dilution from strong supercooling and by the subsequent imprinting of spatial inhomogeneities. This points toward darkogenesis associated with the phase transition as a consistent framework, in which dark-sector transport erases the inhomogeneity before it is transferred to visible baryons.

title: The galactic HI-to-halo mass relation from isolated galaxies to cosmological hydrodynamic simulations
background_knowledge: 中性氢（HI）是星系中恒星形成的主要冷气态原料，而暗物质晕构成了星系形成与演化的基础引力骨架。星系的HI质量与暗物质晕质量之间的关系，对于理解星系如何从星系际介质中吸积气体以及反馈机制如何调节星系形成具有关键意义。在星系演化研究中，天文学家通常会利用宇宙学流体动力学模拟（如IllustrisTNG、SIMBA等）来重现这些复杂的重子物理过程，但这些理论模型的准确性必须经过高精度观测样本（如高分辨率旋转曲线和孤立星系数据）的严格检验与校准。
contribution: 本文结合高度孤立星系样本（AMIGA）和GHASP数据扩展了前人研究，发现在跨越近五个数量级的恒星质量范围内，盘星系的中性氢质量与暗物质晕质量之比保持高度恒定（对数值约为-1.90，散射仅0.36 dex），且该规律不受星系孤立环境的影响。这一高度自相似的观测结果与当前宇宙学流体动力学模拟所预测的质量依赖性（尤其是大质量端的截断现象）形成鲜明对比，表明旋转支撑的盘星系中存在某种与质量无关的气体自我调节机制，揭示了现有理论模型在重子物理反馈上的局限性。
summary: The relation between HI and dark matter (DM) halo masses provides key insights into gas accretion and the regulation of galaxy formation. In a previous study based on SPARC and LITTLE THINGS samples, we showed that the ratio between HI mass and DM halo mass remains approximately constant with stellar mass for nearby disc galaxies ($\log(M_{HI}/M_{200})=-1.90$ with a $1σ$ scatter of 0.37 dex). In this work, we extend that analysis by incorporating galaxies from the Analysis of the interstellar Medium in Isolated GAlaxies (AMIGA) sample and from the Gassendi HAlpha survey of SPirals (GHASP). The AMIGA sample provides the most rigorously selected sample of isolated galaxies in the local Universe, well-suited for testing whether the relation found in the previous samples holds in interaction-free galaxies. We construct mass models from high-resolution rotation curves and infrared photometry, and derive DM halo parameters. We confirm the proportionality between HI and DM halo masses and find a nearly constant HI-mass-to-halo-mass ratio of $\log(M_{HI}/M_{200})=-1.90$ over nearly five orders of magnitude in stellar mass ($7\leq\log(M_{\star}/M_\odot)\leq 11.5$), with a $1σ$ scatter of 0.36 dex. The AMIGA and GHASP samples are statistically consistent with the relation previously found for the SPARC and LITTLE THINGS samples, indicating that it is robust across galaxies spanning a broad range of isolation levels. In contrast, cosmological hydrodynamic simulations such as SIMBA, IllustrisTNG, and NIHAO predict a dependence on stellar mass, with a break at the high stellar mass end for disc galaxies ($M_{\star}>10^{10}M_{\odot}$). Our results thus further demonstrate that the HI-mass-to-halo-mass ratio is remarkably self-similar across rotationally-supported disc galaxies, hinting at mass-independent self-regulation mechanisms that are not yet understood in current theoretical models.

title: Interference Meets Inference: Bayesian Time-Series Modeling of Radio-Frequency Interference
background_knowledge: 射电天文学通过接收来自宇宙的微弱射电波段信号来研究天体物理现象。然而，现代射电天文观测面临的一个重大挑战是射电频率干扰（Radio-Frequency Interference, RFI），即由人类活动（如通信卫星、无线电广播、雷达等）产生的强电磁辐射。准确识别并剔除这些干扰是射电天文数据处理流水线中的关键步骤。传统方法通常将数据标记为绝对的“干净”或“受污染”（即二元“硬”分类），这种方式难以量化识别过程中的置信度，也无法将分类误差传递到后续的科学统计分析中。引入贝叶斯推理与概率模型可以为信号分类提供更具统计意义的“软”标签，从而更好地处理不确定性。
contribution: 该研究将射电频率干扰（RFI）检测转化为一维时间序列的异常检测问题，开发了一种贝叶斯概率混合模型框架。该模型联合描述平滑变化的天文背景与异常污染成分，为每个时间样本分配其属于RFI状态的后验概率，从而提供“软”分类标签。应用于2014年默奇森宽场阵列（MWA）数据的分析表明，与传统输出“硬”标签的SSINS软件流水线相比，该混合模型不仅达到了相似甚至更优的分类效果，还额外提供了RFI污染及其不确定性的概率描述，并支持将分类的不确定性传播到下游的数据统计中。
summary: Radio-frequency interference (RFI) remains a major challenge for modern radio astronomy experiments. In this work, we cast RFI detection as a one-dimensional time-series anomaly-detection problem and develop a probabilistic mixture-model framework for separating a smoothly varying astronomical background from anomalous contamination. The model jointly describes the clean and contaminated components and assigns each time sample a posterior probability of belonging to the RFI state, rather than relying solely on binary flags. This probabilistic formulation provides a measure of classification confidence, enables uncertainty propagation into derived downstream statistics, and offers additional information for investigating ambiguous events. We apply the framework to observations from the Murchison Widefield Array collected in 2014, producing "soft" classification labels and seasonal RFI trends. We perform a parallel analysis using the Sky-Subtracted Incoherent Noise Spectrum software pipeline (SSINS), which produces "hard" classification labels. Overall, the mixture model provides similar and in some cases superior classification results while providing a complementary probabilistic description of RFI contamination and its uncertainty.

title: Quasinormal-mode redshifts of black holes in galactic halos with radial pressures
background_knowledge: 黑洞在受到外部微扰后，会通过发射引力波逐渐恢复到稳定状态，这一“铃鸣”（ringdown）过程的特征振荡模式被称为准正则模（Quasinormal Modes, QNMs）。准正则模的频率和阻尼时间仅由黑洞的质量、自旋和电荷等基本参量决定，被视为黑洞的“光谱指纹”，是检验广义相对论和探测黑洞性质的直接工具。然而，真实宇宙中的黑洞并非完全孤立，它们通常深埋于星系暗物质晕的中心。暗物质晕的质量分布及其状态方程会轻微改变黑洞周围的时空度规，进而通过引力红移等机制对黑洞的光环（light ring）和准正则模谱产生修正。理解并量化这种环境效应，对于未来高精度引力波天文学中准确提取黑洞参数以及探究暗物质的物理本质至关重要。
contribution: 本文研究了具有非零径向压力的星系暗物质晕对黑洞准正则模产生的红移效应。研究将暗物质晕建模为具有广义密度轮廓和常数径向状态方程参数 $w$ 的各向异性流体，并构建了相应的静态球对称时空。分析表明，对于稀薄暗物质晕且 $w \neq -1$ 的情况，光环角频率与李雅普诺夫指数会获得相同的主导阶引力红移，使得准正则频率的实部和虚部发生普适的偏移，这一发现将前人 $w=0$ 的普适红移关系推广到了更宽泛的物理场景。反之，当 $w=-1$ 时，该普适关系被破坏，主导的共同红移因子消失，修正项受到黑洞与晕尺度层级的进一步压抑，其主要贡献由暗物质晕的内部轮廓控制。标量场准正则模谱的数值计算证实了上述解析的程函（eikonal）近似结果。
summary: We investigate the black-hole quasinormal mode redshifts induced by a galactic dark-matter halo with nonvanishing radial pressure. The halo is described by an anisotropic fluid with a generalized density profile and a constant radial equation-of-state parameter $w$. We construct the corresponding static, spherically symmetric spacetime and study the resulting corrections to the unstable light ring and quasinormal-mode spectrum. For dilute halos and $w\neq -1$, the light-ring angular frequency and Lyapunov exponent acquire the same leading-order gravitational redshift, implying a universal shift of the real and imaginary parts of the quasinormal frequencies. The magnitude of this effect depends on both the halo structure and the radial pressure. This universal redshift relation holds not only in the case of $w=0$ that has been discovered in the literature but also in a much wider scenario, supporting its importance in black hole spectroscopy. On the other hand, the case $w=-1$ is qualitatively different: the factor that corresponds to the leading common redshift vanishes, the corrections are further suppressed by the hierarchy between the black-hole and halo scales, and the universal relation is broken, with the dominant contribution controlled by the inner halo profile. Our numerical computations of scalar-field quasinormal mode spectra confirm the analytic eikonal results.

title: The lifetimes and properties of Little Red Dots in the AMBRA simulation
background_knowledge: “小红点”（Little Red Dots, LRDs）是詹姆斯·韦伯空间望远镜（JWST）在早期宇宙（通常红移 z>4）中发现的一类新颖且引人注目的致密且极其偏红的天体。目前的观测和理论普遍认为，这些天体主要由被致密气体或尘埃严重遮蔽的活动星系核（AGN）驱动，代表了早期宇宙中超大质量黑洞与其宿主星系共同快速生长的关键阶段。由于距离遥远且存在严重的遮蔽效应，直接观测其内部物理过程极具挑战。宇宙学流体动力学模拟通过在计算机中演化暗物质和重子物质，结合恒星形成和黑洞反馈等物理模型，并生成可与真实望远镜数据对比的“模拟观测（mock observations）”，是揭示这些高红移极端天体的起源、演化阶段及生命周期的核心研究范式。
contribution: 本文利用AMBRA宇宙学流体动力学模拟，通过构建红移5至8之间的星系与AGN模拟观测数据，对“小红点”（LRDs）的性质和生命周期进行了系统分析。研究发现，采用“气体遮蔽”（gas-enshrouded）的AGN辐射模型对于重现暗弱的LRD至关重要；同时，引入未分辨的AGN光变效应能使模拟中LRD数量随红移的演化趋势与实际观测相符。研究揭示，LRD并非一种特殊结构的天体，而是既存的黑洞-星系系统所经历的一个特定演化阶段，该阶段的出现主要取决于AGN相对于宿主星系的相对亮度。作者进一步估算得出，大多数LRD的寿命在3到300百万年（Myr）之间，且寿命随黑洞和宿主星系质量的增加而变长。其中，低质量LRD更依赖于气体遮蔽的AGN环境，寿命较短（约30 Myr）；而高质量LRD对AGN环境敏感度较低，但要求宿主星系足够致密，其寿命较长（约100 Myr）。
summary: We identify and analyze the little red dots (LRDs) in the AMBRA cosmological hydrodynamic simulation, by producing mock observations of the galaxies and active galactic nuclei (AGN) between redshifts 5 and 8. We produce these mock observations with both a standard AGN emission model, and a ``gas-enshrouded'' model, and find that the presence of a gas-enshrouded AGN is instrumental to the reproduction of dim LRDs (F444W magnitude $>$ 26.0). We find a steeper decrease in LRD density between $z=5$ and $z=8$ within AMBRA than seen in observations, resulting in a relative underproduction of LRDs beyond $z\sim6$ in AMBRA. With the addition of unresolved AGN variability, the decline with redshift flattens, and the LRD redshift evolution in AMBRA becomes broadly consistent with other theoretical datasets, and closer to that seen in observations. We find that the LRDs in AMBRA are pre-existing black hole--galaxy systems that are undergoing an LRD phase, selected primarily by the brightness of the AGN relative to its host. While the exact duration of these LRD phases is not possible to determine due to the unresolved nature of the AGN environment, we use the available time-series data to place limits on the lifetimes of the LRDs in AMBRA. We find that the vast majority of LRDs in AMBRA have lifetimes between $\sim3$ and $\sim 300$ Myr with LRD lifetime increasing with both black hole and host galaxy mass. The lower mass LRDs are more dependent on housing a gas-enshrouded AGN, and have shorter lifetimes ($\rm \sim30~Myr$). The higher mass LRDs are less sensitive to their AGN environment, but require more compact host galaxies, and have longer lifetimes ($\rm \sim100~Myr$).

title: N/O-enhanced chemical enrichment by massive stars: the interplay of optically-thick winds and rotation
background_knowledge: 詹姆斯·韦伯空间望远镜（JWST）的最新观测在宇宙早期（高红移）星系中发现了异常偏高的氮氧丰度比（N/O）。在恒星物理与星系化学演化中，大质量恒星（特别是处于沃尔夫-拉叶/WR阶段的恒星）是星际介质化学增丰的重要源头。恒星内部的碳氮氧（CNO）循环会大量合成氮元素，而恒星的自转能有效促进内部物质混合，将富氮物质带至表面；同时，强烈的恒星风（尤其是光学厚星风）能将这些演化后期的核合成产物大量抛射到星际空间。因此，大质量恒星的星风机制与自转效应的相互作用，是理解早期星系异常化学丰度模式及星系演化历史的关键物理图像。
contribution: 本文使用MESA单星演化代码构建了贫金属大质量恒星（20-100太阳质量）演化模型网格，系统计算了在不同初始自转速率下，包含与不包含光学厚星风两种情况下的金属产率。研究发现，两种模型均能在星暴后数百万年内产生显著的N/O增丰；但光学厚星风模型在演化至3-4 Myr时，会因富含碳/氧的星风大量喷发而迅速回归至正常的低N/O状态。该光学厚星风演化情景成功重现了三个具有直接WR星光谱特征的高红移星系（RXCJ2248-ID、Sunburst Arc和MARTA 4327）的星云C、N、O和He丰度模式，揭示了它们分别处于高N/O状态转变前、中、后的连贯演化序列；而仅考虑光学薄星风的模型则因抛射的碳氧过少而无法解释观测结果。
summary: Recent JWST observations have revealed a sample of high-$z$ galaxies with highly-enhanced N/O abundance ratios, $\log\rm (N/O)\gtrsim -1.1$. Strong optically-thick winds of rotating massive stars going through the Wolf-Rayet (WR) phase provide a viable explanation for such N/O enhancements, supported by the direct spectroscopic WR signatures discovered in a few galaxies. Such strong winds are also needed to reproduce the single WR stars in the Small Magellanic Cloud (SMC). Here, we compute the metal yields of massive ($\sim 20-100\ \rm M_\odot$), metal-poor stars using two sets of \textsc{mesa} single stellar evolution models with and without optically-thick winds in a dense grid of metallicities ($Z_\star\sim 0.001-0.0045$) and initial spins ($ω\equivΩ/Ω_{\rm crit}\sim 0-0.7$). Considering an initial spin distribution based on observations of O-type stars in the SMC, we find that both sets produce strong N/O enhancements up to $\rm \log(N/O)\sim 0.1$ within a few Myr after a starburst. The models with optically-thick winds undergo a rapid transition from high N/O to the `normal' state of $\rm \log(N/O)\sim -1.5$ at $t\sim 3-4$~Myr driven by C/O-rich winds, while the transition is slower and weaker without optically-thick winds. The optically-thick-wind scenario can reproduce the nebular C, N, O, and He abundance patterns of three representative high-$z$ galaxies showing direct WR signatures: RXCJ2248-ID, Sunburst Arc, and MARTA 4327, with stellar metallicities and ages similar to those inferred from SED-fitting. This can be interpreted as a coherent evolution sequence captured before ($t\lesssim 3$~Myr), during ($t\sim 3-4$~Myr), and after ($t\gtrsim 5$~Myr) the transition. In contrast, the optically-thin-wind-only scenario ejects much less C and O via winds and cannot reproduce Sunburst Arc and MARTA 4327. The yields are available at https://zenodo.org/records/22897057.

title: DIISC-VII: Linking Radial Gas Motions to Anomalously Low Metallicity Star-forming Regions in the XUV Disk of NGC 3344
background_knowledge: 在星系形成与演化理论中，“由内而外”（inside-out）是盘星系生长的重要物理图像。在许多盘星系的外围区域，观测到了延伸的紫外（XUV）盘，这表明在距离星系中心很远的地方依然活跃着近期的恒星形成活动。为了维持这种恒星形成，星系需要不断从星系周介质或外部吸积贫金属的新鲜冷气体。理论预测，这些贫金属气体的流入会稀释外盘星际介质的化学丰度，导致局部出现金属丰度异常偏低的电离氢（H II）区。然而，在观测上直接探测到气体的径向流动并将其与低金属丰度异常建立确凿的物理联系，一直以来是一项极具挑战性的工作。
contribution: 本研究利用VLA的高分辨率中性氢（H I）21厘米成像和MMT的多缝光学光谱，分析了NGC 3344星系中76个H II区的运动学与气相金属丰度。观测发现该星系存在负的径向金属丰度梯度，且XUV盘内H II区的金属丰度弥散是内盘的两倍，部分区域表现出异常低的金属丰度。通过对H I盘的运动学建模，首次直接探测到XUV盘内存在平均速度为6 km/s的气体径向流入，并结合化学演化模型证实了这些气流稀释了局部金属丰度并维持了恒星形成。该工作提供了首个直接的观测证据，揭示了气体径向流动如何支持恒星盘的扩张并驱动星系‘由内而外’的生长。
summary: We present evidence connecting anomalously low-metallicity regions to radial gas inflows in the extended ultraviolet (XUV) disk of the galaxy NGC 3344. Anomalously low-metallicity H II regions are hypothesized to result from the accretion of metal-poor gas, but a direct link between gas flows and low metallicity gas has not been previously established. We use high-resolution H I-21cm imaging from the Very Large Array to trace neutral gas kinematics and multi-slit optical spectroscopy from the MMT to trace the gas-phase metallicity of 76 H II regions in NGC 3344. The galaxy exhibits a negative radial metallicity gradient of $-0.378$ dex $\mathrm{R}_{25}^{-1}$, with H II regions in the XUV disk showing nearly twice the metallicity scatter of those in the inner disk and several showing an anomalously low metallicity. Modeling the H I disk as tilted rings with 3DBarolo, we find gas moving radially inwards within the XUV disk at an average radial velocity of 6 $\mathrm{km\ s^{-1}}$, likely fueling star formation and diluting the metallicity, thereby producing anomalously low metallicity regions. Chemical evolution models indicate that the gas fraction, effective yield, and mass-loading factor profiles are disrupted at the onset of the XUV disk, as expected from recent gas flows. This example is the first direct detection of how radial gas flows can support stellar disk expansion and cause inside-out galaxy growth.

title: A Search For Stellar-mass Black Holes Via Astrometric Microlensing II: 2012-2015 Keck Candidates
background_knowledge: 银河系中预计存在约一亿个恒星级黑洞，但大多数是孤立存在的，由于不产生明显的电磁辐射，极难被直接观测到。目前，引力微透镜效应是探测孤立恒星级黑洞唯一被证实有效的方法。当一个致密天体（透镜，如黑洞）从背景恒星前方穿过时，其强大的引力场会弯曲背景星的光线，不仅会导致背景恒星的光度发生短暂放大（测光微透镜效应），还会使其在天空中的视位置发生极其微小的偏移（天体测量微透镜效应）。通过结合大视场巡天望远镜的长时间基线测光数据与大型地基或空间望远镜的高精度天体测量数据，天文学家可以精确计算出透镜天体的质量，从而将暗黑的黑洞与暗弱的主序星或白矮星有效区分开来。
contribution: 本研究结合了OGLE和MOA长达10年的测光数据与Keck天文台自适应光学系统的高分辨率测光和天体测量数据，对4个长时标引力微透镜事件的透镜天体质量进行了限制。研究排除了其中3个事件为黑洞的可能性（透镜更可能是普通恒星或白矮星）；事件OGLE-2015-BLG-0211仍保留为黑洞候选体，尽管受限于观测条件其质量上限约束较宽（1σ上限为3.2倍太阳质量）。该观测结果与当前银河系理论模型的模拟预期相符，并指出未来需借助Rubin、Roman以及JWST等新一代观测设施来获取更大样本的孤立黑洞，以进一步限制其形成机制。
summary: The Milky Way is expected to host $\sim$10$^8$ stellar-mass black holes with an uncertain binary fraction. The only proven method to detect isolated stellar mass black holes is gravitational microlensing. Here we report the results of a microlensing search for black holes with photometry and astrometry. By combining 10 years of seeing-limited photometry from OGLE and MOA with diffraction-limited photometry and astrometry from adaptive optics imagers at the W.~M.~Keck Observatory, we constrain lens masses for OGLE-2012-BLG-0169, OGLE-2014-BLG-0613/MOA-2015-BLG-041, OGLE-2015-BLG-0029/MOA-2015-BLG-170, and OGLE-2015-BLG-0211. Of the four long-duration microlensing events monitored, we ruled out black hole lenses in 3 events, which likely have stellar or white dwarf lenses. OGLE-2015-BLG-0211 remains a black hole candidate with a poorly constrained lens mass with a 1$σ$ upper mass limit of 3.2$M_\odot$ and a 3$σ$ upper mass limit of 21.6$M_\odot$. This event suffered from poor observing conditions and significant astrometric reference frame uncertainties, but its analysis may benefit from additional astrometric data in the upcoming Gaia Data Release 4. Of the six long-timescale ($t_E>100$ days) microlensing events from this work and previous studies, one black hole has been confirmed with a second not ruled out. We briefly examine Galactic model simulations and find that our result agrees with current expectations. Ultimately, we need a larger sample of isolated black holes to constrain their formation processes. This will be possible in the coming years with Rubin and Roman, as well as improved astrometry from JWST and large, ground-based telescopes equipped with adaptive optics.

title: Multivariate Continuous-Time Autoregressive Moving Average Processes for Astronomical Multiband Time Series
background_knowledge: 现代大规模天文巡天项目会在多个光学波段上产生海量的多变量时间序列观测数据。这类天文时域数据通常具有采样不规则（非均匀采样）、测量误差呈现异方差性，以及部分波段存在数据缺失等复杂特点。在时域天文学中，连续时间自回归滑动平均（CARMA）过程常被用于拟合天体（如活动星系核/类星体、变星等）的光变曲线，从而提取其内部的随机动力学特征与功率谱信息。然而，以往的分析方法通常局限于对单个波段进行独立建模，难以充分利用不同波段间光变演化的高度物理相关性来提升参数推断的精度与稳健性。
contribution: 本文开发了一种结构化的多变量连续时间自回归滑动平均（MCARMA）统计框架，专门用于处理具有不规则采样、异方差误差和缺失数据的天文多波段时间序列。该框架允许各波段具备独立的随机动力学特征，同时通过相关的布朗驱动过程对跨波段依赖性进行建模，并利用状态空间和谱表示实现基于似然函数的推断。作者提出了一种两阶段估计程序以提高数值稳定性，模拟结果表明，相较于单波段独立拟合，多变量联合估计在绝大多数情况下显著提升了参数与功率谱的恢复精度。对SDSS Stripe 82中三个类星体的实际应用进一步证明，多波段联合建模能有效利用跨波段依赖性来约束边缘动力学，并能够提供更准确的模型阶数与能谱推断。相关算法已开源为Python软件包`mcarma`。
summary: Large-scale astronomical surveys provide unprecedented volumes of multivariate time-series observations obtained through multiple optical filters. We develop a structured multivariate continuous-time autoregressive moving average (MCARMA) framework for multi-band time series with irregular sampling, heteroscedastic measurement errors, and partially observed bands. The framework allows band-specific stochastic dynamics while modeling cross-band dependence through correlated Brownian driving processes, with state-space and spectral representations enabling likelihood-based inference and interpretation of the fitted stochastic dynamics. We develop a two-stage estimation procedure in which a numerically stabilized preliminary fit initializes subsequent maximum likelihood estimation. Simulations show that higher-order stochastic structure can be recovered when its characteristic features are adequately resolved, but can become weakly identifiable because of limited temporal resolution or near pole--zero cancellation. Joint multivariate estimation improves parameter recovery in 23 of 27 settings and spectral recovery in 26 of 27 settings relative to separate single-band fits. Three Sloan Digital Sky Survey Stripe 82 quasars, respectively favoring MCARMA(1,0), MCARMA(2,0), and MCARMA(2,1), illustrate how joint multiband modeling uses cross-band dependence to inform marginal dynamics and can yield different model-order and spectral inference. The methodology is implemented in the Python package mcarma.

title: Interstellar extinction of classical Cepheids from neighboring stars I. Methodology and application to 16 Galactic Cepheids
background_knowledge: 经典造父变星是宇宙距离尺度的基本校准天体，其周光关系（Period-Luminosity relation）是测量星系距离的重要‘标准烛光’。随着Gaia卫星等天体测量项目提供极高精度的视差数据，天文学家有望以前所未有的精度校准银河系内的造父变星周光关系。然而，星际空间中的尘埃会对星光产生吸收和散射作用（即星际消光），导致星光变暗且颜色偏红。目前，星际消光的修正误差仍然是限制周光关系校准精度的主要不确定性来源。由于造父变星本身具有复杂的光度周期性变化，直接精确测量其自身的消光参数极具挑战性。
contribution: 提出了一种基于邻近场星来精确推断银河系造父变星星际消光的创新方法，并成功应用于16颗试点样本。研究团队利用Gaia DR3天体测量数据筛选出物理空间上靠近造父变星的场星，通过VLT/FLAMES中高分辨率光谱确定其大气参数，进而拟合光谱能量分布（SED）得出个体消光。通过重建三维消光分布并插值到造父变星位置，该方法成功测定了样本的消光值(Av)、总消光与选择性消光比(Rv)以及色超(E(B-V))，平均精度达到约5%，有效避开了造父变星光度变化带来的不确定性，为未来更高精度的宇宙距离尺度校准提供了可靠方案。
summary: Galactic Cepheid variable stars are fundamental calibrators of the cosmic distance scale through their Period-Luminosity (PL) relation. The high-precision parallaxes expected from Gaia Data Release 4 (DR4) will enable a calibration of the Milky Way PL relation with unprecedented precision. This will place stringent requirements on interstellar extinction corrections, which remain a dominant source of uncertainty. We strive to derive highly accurate extinction values for Galactic Cepheids. We present an innovative methodology relying on the analysis of neighboring field stars and apply it to a pilot sample of 16 Cepheids. We identify physically near field stars using Gaia DR3 astrometry. For these stars, we determine atmospheric parameters from medium- to high-resolution VLT/FLAMES spectroscopy. Fixing these parameters, we derive individual extinctions by fitting spectral energy distributions constructed from Gaia XP spectra and infrared photometry. We then reconstruct the three-dimensional distribution of extinction and interpolate extinction to the Cepheid position. We report extinction Av, total-to-selective extinction ratio Rv, and color excess E(B-V) for all 16 Cepheids. Our method achieves a mean precision of approximately 5%, improving upon typical literature values, with no significant systematic offset detected. We demonstrate that using field stars bypasses uncertainties associated with Cepheid variability and can provide robust extinction estimates for Galactic Cepheids.

title: The Lumina Project: Morphology of Ionized Bubbles and Neutral Islands
background_knowledge: 宇宙再电离时期（Epoch of Reionization, EoR）是宇宙演化历史中的一个关键阶段。在大爆炸后约几十万年，宇宙冷却并复合形成中性氢，进入‘黑暗时代’。随着第一代恒星、星系以及类星体的形成，它们释放出的强烈紫外辐射开始逐渐电离周围的中性星系际介质（IGM），形成逐渐膨胀的电离气泡（HII区）。这些气泡不断成核、膨胀并相互合并（渗透），最终使得整个宇宙的星系际介质被完全电离，但在再电离末期仍会残留少量孤立的‘中性岛’。当前，随着詹姆斯·韦伯太空望远镜（JWST）和下一代21厘米射电干涉阵列（如SKA）的投入使用，天文学家亟需高精度的大尺度辐射流体力学模拟来提供理论模型，以准确解释这些设施带来的多波段3D观测数据。
contribution: 本研究利用500 Mpc$^3$的大尺度辐射流体力学模拟（Lumina项目），结合3D分水岭算法，系统分析了再电离时期电离气泡及晚期残余中性岛的三维几何形态与物理性质。主要发现包括：(1) 电离气泡的体积加权特征半径随红移显著演化，从 z>10 的~1 cMpc 增长至 z<6 的>100 cMpc；(2) 在大部分再电离时期，气泡整体呈长椭球状（prolate），但在 z~6 的渗透晚期，三轴参数分布呈现双峰特征，被少数超大气泡主导的扁圆（oblate）峰凸显；(3) 气泡内部气体演化符合‘由内向外’的再电离图像，气体过密度中位数随时间向宇宙平均值回落，且较大气泡内部具有更高的紫外辐射能量密度；(4) z<6 时的残余中性岛特征尺度峰值约为10 cMpc，且主要呈长椭球状，反映了再电离末期残余结构的各向异性。
summary: The Epoch of Reionization is characterized by the nucleation, expansion, and percolation of ionized bubbles in the intergalactic medium. Interpreting emerging multi-wavelength observations from facilities such as JWST and next-generation 21 cm interferometers requires a detailed theoretical understanding of the 3D morphology of these HII regions and of the residual neutral structures that survive near the end of reionization. We analyze the geometry and physical properties of ionized bubbles and late-time neutral islands in the large-volume 500 Mpc$^3$ radiation-hydrodynamics simulation Lumina. We identify discrete structures with a 3D watershed method and measure their volumes, shape tensors, and internal gas properties. The volume-weighted bubble size distributions evolve substantially across the EoR: characteristic radii shift from Reff~1 cMpc at z>10 to Reff>100 cMpc by z< 6, while watershed-derived sizes exceed line-of-sight mean-free-path measurements by roughly a factor of 3 at intermediate redshifts. The bulk bubble population is predominantly prolate through most of the EoR. By z~6, however, the volume-weighted distribution of the triaxiality parameter T, which distinguishes flattened from elongated structures, becomes bimodal in the fiducial segmentation, with a sharp oblate peak near T~0.25 associated with a small number of very large bubbles during late percolation. The properties of bubble interiors are consistent with inside-out reionization, with median gas overdensities within bubbles decreasing from $δ$~1 at z=15 toward the cosmic mean by z=6. Beyond a minimum near the resolution scale, the median internal UV radiation energy density increases with bubble size. The residual neutral islands at z< 6 peak in volume-weighted size near Reff~10 cMpc and remain predominantly prolate, consistent with anisotropic residual neutral structure near the end of reionization.

title: CECILIA: Multi-line Constraints on Excess Nebular Emission from Low-Ionization Gas at Cosmic Noon
background_knowledge: 在宇宙演化历史中，红移z~2-3的时期被称为“宇宙正午”（Cosmic Noon），这是宇宙整体恒星形成率达到顶峰的阶段。研究这一时期星系的星际介质（ISM）属性对于理解星系的形成与演化至关重要。天文学家通常利用星云发射线（尤其是[O I]、[S II]等低电离线）来诊断星际气体的物理条件、化学元素丰度（如硫氧比S/O）以及电离源机制。在传统的星际介质图像中，发射线主要来自大质量恒星周围的光致电离区（HII区）；但在低红移星系中，部分低电离线也被发现来源于HII区之外的弥散电离气体（DIG）或由激波（shocks）驱动。随着詹姆斯·韦伯太空望远镜（JWST）的观测，天文学家得以获取高红移星系的高精度静息系光学光谱，这促使研究者重新评估经典的发射线诊断方法与光致电离模型在早期宇宙中的适用性。
contribution: 本文利用JWST/NIRSpec的超深场光谱（基于CECILIA巡天数据），对19个“宇宙正午”时期星系中的低电离发射线[O I]λ6302和[S II]λλ6718,33进行了定量分析。研究发现，在利用S2-BPT图诊断高红移星系时，必须考虑亚太阳标准（sub-solar）的硫元素丰度模式。结合光致电离模型模拟器Cue的分析，作者发现这些星系中约48%的[S II]和55%的[O I]发射线辐射无法用传统的HII区模型来解释。对比现有模型，未发现湍流或激波驱动这些“多余辐射”的明确证据，因此推测这些额外辐射可能源于HII区外部的弥散电离气体（DIG），尽管其物理性质可能与低红移宇宙中的DIG有所不同。研究还指出，若在计算中不加区分地包含这些来自非恒星形成区的气体辐射，将会在测算气态硫丰度（12+log(S/H)）时引入最高达0.1 dex的系统性偏差。
summary: Spectroscopy from JWST has offered unique insights into elemental abundance patterns at Cosmic Noon (z~2-3), most notably a growing census of sub-solar S/O. These new measurements, coupled with new observations of [O I]λ6302 at z>1, motivate an updated study of neutral and low-ionization emission within Cosmic Noon galaxies. In this letter, we present a new analysis of [O I]λ6302 and [S II]λλ6718,33 in 19 galaxies observed using ultra-deep JWST/NIRSpec spectroscopy as part of the CECILIA survey. We find that it is necessary to consider sub-solar abundance patterns in sulfur at high-z when analyzing galaxies on the S2-BPT, and that this correction reveals the potential of additional emission sources in CECILIA galaxies. Using the photoionization model emulator Cue, we find that ~48% of observed [S II] and ~55% of observed [O I] emission in CECILIA galaxies cannot be reproduced by conventional HII region models. We find no clear evidence for turbulence or shocks driving this excess emission when comparing to existing models. Our findings imply that this excess emission may originate in diffuse ionized gas outside of H II regions, though its nature may be different than that of low-z DIG. Further, we find that including emission from gas outside of star-forming regions can incur a small bias up to 0.1 dex in 12+log(S/H).

title: Sterile Neutrino Dark Matter Cries for GeV Heavy Neutral Leptons
background_knowledge: 标准模型在粒子物理学中取得了巨大成功，但仍无法解释几个关键的宇宙学与基础物理难题：中微子的非零质量、宇宙中物质与反物质的不对称性（重子不对称性）以及暗物质的本质。中微子最小标准模型（νMSM）是通过引入三个右手中微子（即重中性轻子，HNL或惰性中微子）对标准模型进行的极简扩展。在该物理图像中，两个较重的HNL通过跷跷板机制赋予普通中微子质量，并在早期宇宙的电弱能标下产生重子不对称性，进而在QCD能标下产生巨大的轻子不对称性；而第三个较轻的态则通过共振机制转化为惰性中微子，成为暗物质的天然候选者。
contribution: 本文克服了以往在描述重中性轻子（HNL）贯穿宇宙历史的量子动力学方程上的理论不足，首次对中微子最小标准模型（νMSM）进行了全面的参数空间扫描。研究发现，νMSM仅在一个各方向均受严格限制的特定参数空间内，才能同时完美解释中微子质量、重子不对称性与暗物质丰度。该空间预言的HNL质量在GeV量级，完全处于SHiP实验、大型强子对撞机（LHC）及未来轻子对撞机的探测范围内。此外，论文给出了关于HNL衰变分支比、CP破坏和轻子数违例（LNV）的具体预测，使得这一解释宇宙物质与暗物质共同起源的模型具备了极高的实验可检验性。
summary: The ordinary and dark matter in the Universe may share a common origin in the framework of a minimal extension of the Standard Model by three right-handed neutrinos. A pair of such heavy neutral leptons (HNLs) can give masses to neutrinos, generate the baryon asymmetry at the electroweak scale and produce a large lepton asymmetry at the QCD scale, which is then resonantly transformed into an abundance of the third state that acts as sterile neutrino dark matter. The minimality of this setup, known as Neutrino Minimal Standard Model ($ν$MSM), makes it highly predictive. Earlier attempts to pin down the properties of the HNLs based on the requirement to simultaneously explain the neutrino masses as well as the baryonic and dark matter abundances were hampered by an incomplete understanding of the quantum kinetic equations describing the HNLs throughout cosmic history. We perform the first parameter scan of the $ν$MSM in which this shortcoming has been overcome. We find that the $ν$MSM provides a common explanation for all aforementioned phenomena only within a well-defined parameter space that is limited in all directions, with HNL masses kinematically accessible by the SHiP experiment as well as searches at the LHC and future lepton colliders. Further predictions for the HNL decay branching ratios, CP-violation, and lepton number violation (LNV) make the model highly testable, bringing a discovery of the common origin of neutrino masses and all matter in the Universe within reach of existing and planned experiments.

title: Detection of metal absorption lines in quasar spectra: a neural network approach using U-Net
background_knowledge: 类星体（Quasar）是宇宙中极其明亮的活动星系核。当类星体的光穿越浩瀚的宇宙空间到达地球时，会穿过星系际介质（IGM）或星系周围介质（CGM）。这些介质中的气体（包括氢和各类重元素金属）会在类星体的连续光谱上留下特征性的吸收线（如金属吸收线）。通过分析这些吸收线，天文学家能够探测宇宙气体的物理状态，进而研究星系形成与化学丰度的演化。随着当前和未来大型光谱巡天项目（如WEAVE、DESI等）的开展，观测到的类星体光谱在数量和分辨率上都呈爆炸式增长，传统的依赖人工或简单算法的识别方式已难以应对，迫切需要引入深度学习（如U-Net这类常用于图像或序列分割的神经网络）等高效、精确的自动化检测技术。
contribution: 本研究提出了一种基于U-Net神经网络的新型自动化方法，专门用于检测类星体光谱中的金属吸收线特征。研究团队在静止系波长区间 1230 Å ≤ λ_RF ≤ 3095 Å 的WEAVE模拟光谱上对模型进行了测试，分别评估了其在理想数据以及经过模拟连续谱拟合（贴近真实观测）后的表现。结果显示，当吸收线信噪比（S/N_line）约为4时，U-Net模型在完整性、纯度和F1分数等指标上均达到了约90%的优异性能。对于信噪比大于等于5的假阳性检测，大多落在阻尼莱曼阿尔法系统（DLAs）宽吸收翼的尾部；同时，连续谱拟合步骤对信噪比≥4的检测性能影响可以忽略不计。该U-Net架构为当前及未来的大型光谱巡天提供了一项极具竞争力的吸收线自动化识别工具。
summary: Current and future large spectroscopic surveys are significantly enhancing the volume and resolution of quasar spectra that are observed, which requires the creation of efficient and precise automated techniques to detect absorption features. This study focuses on the detection of metal absorption features using a novel U-Net model on WEAVE-like mock spectra in the quasar rest-frame wavelength interval $1230\,\mathring{\mathrm{A}} \leq λ_{\rm RF} \leq 3095\,\mathring{\mathrm{A}}$. We test the network performance for absorption detection both on ideal data and after simulating the continuum fitting step as applied on real data. The performance of these architectures is evaluated by the completeness, purity, and F1 score reached in bins of signal-to-noise ($\mathrm{S}/ \mathrm{N}_\mathrm{line} $) for the absorption lines and with the absolute fractional flux error for the continuum. The ability to recover the correct line centers is also studied. The U-Net reaches scores of $\approx 90\%$ for all metrics (completeness, purity, and F1 score) at $\mathrm{S}/ \mathrm{N}_\mathrm{line} \approx 4$. All false positive detections with $\mathrm{S}/ \mathrm{N}_\mathrm{line} \geq 5$ fall in the tails of the broad Ly$α$ absorbers distribution of damped Ly$α$ systems. The combination of continuum fitting and line detections has negligible effects on the detection performance at $\mathrm{S}/ \mathrm{N}_\mathrm{line} \geq 4$. Our proposed U-Net architecture offers a competitive tool for the analysis of absorption lines in current and upcoming large spectroscopic surveys and is well-suited to the identification of any absorption line feature.
